qs.why: Kesimpulannya bersyarat: pekan lebih pendek jalan kalau pekerjaannya bisa ditata ulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi cocok untuk semua pemberi kerja mengabaikan syaratnya, karena teks bilang ia “struggles where the hours are the service being sold”. Opsi karena orang bekerja lebih cepat dibantah kalimat “it was seldom because anybody worked faster”. Opsi tanpa bukti berguna terlalu keras, sebab penulis justru menyebut hasilnya “more subversive than the sceptics admit”.

qs: What did most participating firms report?
a small but measurable fall in the volume of work that was completed
the work still got done, and most kept the shorter week afterwards
a rise in sickness absence during the months of the trial
a decision to return to five days once the trial ended

qs.evidence: Most participating firms reported output holding steady, and a majority chose to retain the arrangement once the trial had finished.
qs.answer: the work still got done, and most kept the shorter week afterwards
qs.why: Hasil kerja tetap tuntas, dan mayoritas perusahaan meneruskan pekan pendek setelah uji coba.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penurunan hasil kerja bertentangan dengan laporan bahwa output bertahan. Opsi absen sakit naik membalik arahnya, karena teks bilang absen sakit turun dan kelelahan turun lebih jauh lagi. Opsi kembali ke lima hari menukar pilihan mayoritas, yang justru mempertahankan pengaturan barunya.

qs: Which point is offered as evidence that the trial firms were unusual?
Employers that put themselves forward are not representative.
Recurring meetings were cancelled during the trial period.
Reporting cycles were lengthened in most firms taking part.
Office-based firms did better than those with beds or lathes to staff.

qs.evidence: firms which volunteer for an experiment of this kind are not a random sample of employers
qs.answer: Employers that put themselves forward are not representative.
qs.why: Perusahaan yang mendaftar sendiri bukan sampel acak, jadi hasilnya tidak bisa digeneralkan begitu saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi rapat berulang dibatalkan dan opsi siklus pelaporan diperpanjang keduanya menjelaskan kenapa hasil kerja bertahan, bukan kenapa peserta uji coba tidak mewakili semua perusahaan. Opsi kantor lebih unggul menunjuk batas jenis pekerjaan, dan tetap berlaku meski sampelnya acak.

qs: What can be inferred about firms where a checkout must be staffed?
They achieved the largest falls in reported exhaustion of all.
They were excluded from the trials by the researchers who ran them.
They found it harder, because their hours are the service sold.
They lengthened their reporting cycles more than office firms.

qs.evidence: That also explains why office-based firms fared better than those where a bed, a lathe or a checkout must be attended by somebody.
qs.answer: They found it harder, because their hours are the service sold.
qs.why: Di tempat yang jamnya adalah layanannya, pengaturan ini lebih sulit dan hasilnya kurang bagus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penurunan kelelahan terbesar membalik hasilnya, sebab yang “fared better” adalah perusahaan berbasis kantor. Opsi dikeluarkan dari uji coba menambah keputusan peneliti yang nggak ada di teks; mereka ikut, cuma hasilnya lebih tipis. Opsi memperpanjang siklus pelaporan memindahkan perubahan yang justru dilakukan perusahaan kantor.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The trials were funded by public grants rather than by the participating firms."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The trials were funded by public grants rather than by the participating firms.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Several hundred firms have now run trials in which staff worked roughly eighty per cent of their previous hours for unchanged pay, and the results were monitored rather than merely announced.
qs.why: Teks cuma menyebut ratusan perusahaan menjalankan uji coba dan hasilnya dipantau; soal siapa yang membiayai sama sekali nggak disinggung, jadi kamu nggak bisa menyimpulkan apa pun.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" dan "False" sama-sama butuh keterangan sumber dana, dan teks nggak pernah menyebut hibah maupun siapa yang menanggung biaya uji coba.

author: A science writer reporting on trials of shorter working weeks
setting: Work and economics feature in a popular science magazine

title: Who Decides Which Days
text:
A firm of nine hundred people must finally write down the hybrid policy it has avoided writing for two years. Two directors, both persuaded that full attendance will not return, disagree about what ought to replace it, though both want people in the building sometimes. What divides them is the question of who decides when. Delegation of that authority, rather than the attendance pattern itself, is the substantive matter before them.

The first would fix two anchor days for everybody. Coordination, she argues, is the only defensible reason to travel at all, and a building half full on five separate days delivers none of it. A shared timetable also protects the people whom informal arrangements invariably disadvantage: new joiners, part-time staff and anybody who lacks the confidence to ask. Predictability, on her account, is a form of fairness rather than a constraint upon it. Discretion distributes advantage towards whichever employees are already comfortable exercising it.

The second accepts the coordination argument and distrusts the instrument. A rule imposed centrally will be sensible for some teams and absurd for others, he notes, and the teams for which it is absurd will comply in form while evading it in substance. He would require every team to publish its own pattern, reviewed each quarter, with attendance visible to the whole firm. Where his colleague locates fairness in a fixed timetable, he locates it in a published one. Transparency, in his formulation, substitutes for uniformity as the guarantee of equitable treatment.

The distance between them is smaller than the meetings suggest, and it will not disappear. Both reject attendance as a measure of commitment, both insist that the pattern be written down, and both accept that somebody will lose from any arrangement whatsoever. One of them trusts a rule; the other trusts a rule about how rules get made. Institutional trust, not occupancy statistics, is the currency in which either policy will eventually be judged. Whichever is adopted, the argument that follows will concern trust rather than desks.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this piece?
To lay out two close but competing answers on one policy
To argue that full attendance in the office is certain to return
To recommend two fixed anchor days as the only workable policy
To report how many staff the firm employs across its teams

qs.evidence: What divides them is the question of who decides when.
qs.answer: To lay out two close but competing answers on one policy
qs.why: Penulis memaparkan dua jawaban berdekatan yang bersaing atas satu pertanyaan kebijakan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kehadiran penuh akan kembali dibantah kalimat pembuka: kedua direktur sama-sama yakin itu nggak akan terjadi. Opsi merekomendasikan dua hari tetap memihak satu pihak, padahal penulis nggak memilih. Opsi melaporkan jumlah staf memakai angka latar sebagai maksud tulisan.

qs: Whom does the first director say a shared timetable protects?
directors who need the building to be full on all five days of a week
newcomers, part-time staff and those reluctant to make requests
teams whose own pattern would otherwise have to be published
employees whose commitment is measured by their attendance record

qs.evidence: A shared timetable also protects the people whom informal arrangements invariably disadvantage: new joiners, part-time staff and anybody who lacks the confidence to ask.
qs.answer: newcomers, part-time staff and those reluctant to make requests
qs.why: Jadwal bersama melindungi pendatang baru, pekerja paruh waktu, dan mereka yang enggan meminta.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi direktur yang ingin gedung penuh lima hari justru pola yang keduanya tolak. Opsi tim yang harus menerbitkan polanya adalah usulan direktur kedua, bukan yang dilindungi jadwal bersama. Opsi karyawan yang komitmennya diukur dari kehadiran memakai ukuran yang teks sebut ditolak kedua pihak.

qs: Which point does the second director use against a central rule?
Coordination is the only defensible reason for travelling to work here.
Teams for which the rule makes no sense will obey it only formally.
Attendance should never be treated as a measure of commitment at all.
A pattern reviewed each quarter is easier to publish than to enforce.

qs.evidence: A rule imposed centrally will be sensible for some teams and absurd for others, he notes, and the teams for which it is absurd will comply in form while evading it in substance.
qs.answer: Teams for which the rule makes no sense will obey it only formally.
qs.why: Tim yang aturannya tak masuk akal akan patuh di atas kertas dan mengakalinya dalam praktik.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi koordinasi satu-satunya alasan datang adalah argumen direktur pertama, jadi ia mendukung aturan pusat, bukan menyerangnya. Opsi kehadiran bukan ukuran komitmen adalah titik yang mereka sepakati. Opsi lebih mudah diterbitkan daripada ditegakkan menyerang usulan direktur kedua sendiri dan nggak pernah muncul di teks.

qs: What can be inferred about the disagreement between the two directors?
It concerns whether people should come into the building at all.
It concerns how many days each team ought to spend together.
It concerns whether attendance is a fair measure of commitment.
It concerns where the authority to set the pattern should sit.

qs.evidence: One of them trusts a rule; the other trusts a rule about how rules get made.
qs.answer: It concerns where the authority to set the pattern should sit.
qs.why: Perbedaannya soal siapa yang berwenang menetapkan pola kehadiran, bukan soal hadir atau tidak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi soal datang atau tidak diblokir kalimat “both want people in the building sometimes”. Opsi jumlah hari kelihatan masuk akal, tapi teks menyebut yang membelah mereka adalah “the question of who decides when”. Opsi kehadiran sebagai ukuran komitmen memakai hal yang keduanya tolak bersama.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The second director wants each team's attendance pattern kept within that team."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The second director wants each team's attendance pattern kept within that team.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: He would require every team to publish its own pattern, reviewed each quarter, with attendance visible to the whole firm.
qs.why: Dia justru menuntut pola tiap tim diterbitkan dan kehadirannya terlihat oleh seluruh perusahaan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena membalik maksudnya; "Not stated" salah karena keterbukaan itu dinyatakan.

topic: Two approaches to writing a hybrid working policy
author: A human resources writer reporting an internal debate
setting: Discussion feature in a human resources journal

title: The Placement That Pays Nothing
text:
This paper concerns unpaid internships and the informal apprenticeships which have replaced entry-level employment in several sectors. A survey of 340 placements advertised over six months found that 62 per cent offered no payment of any kind. A third of those described duties indistinguishable from those of a junior employee. The practice is no longer marginal; it has become the ordinary route into at least three professions. Employers describe such arrangements as training even where no instruction has been scheduled.

The cost falls unevenly, which is the substance of the objection. An unpaid placement is affordable to a graduate whose family can house and feed her, and unaffordable to everybody else, so a hiring channel quietly becomes a form of inheritance. Two sectors elsewhere in the region adopted mandatory payment and saw no reduction in the number of placements offered. Average duration did shorten, which suggests that employers had been purchasing time they did not actually need. Paying for the time, on this reading, makes buyers of that time more careful.

Four provisions are proposed. First, any placement lasting more than four weeks must be paid at no less than the statutory minimum. Second, a written agreement must state the learning objectives, the supervisor and the finishing date. Third, advertisements must disclose the payment offered, a requirement that costs the employer almost nothing to meet. Fourth, the inspectorate already visiting these workplaces should add placement records to its existing checklist, which requires no new body and no additional visits.

Two objections deserve an answer rather than a dismissal. Small firms may withdraw from the scheme altogether, so a reduced rate for the first eight weeks is included for employers below twenty staff. Enforcement may also fall upon the employers who keep records instead of those who keep none, which argues for treating the register as a trigger for inspection rather than as proof of compliance. Neither difficulty justifies leaving the present arrangement alone, since continued tolerance of unpaid entry concedes that access to a profession may be purchased with parental subsidy.
qs: What is the main purpose of this paper?
To report the number of placements advertised in the last six months
To argue that entry-level employment has vanished from every sector
To propose rules making longer placements paid and documented
To defend the practice of offering unpaid work to new graduates

qs.evidence: Four provisions are proposed.
qs.answer: To propose rules making longer placements paid and documented
qs.why: Isi utamanya empat ketentuan: penempatan panjang wajib dibayar dan didokumentasikan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi melaporkan jumlah penempatan memakai angka survei sebagai tujuan, padahal angka itu dasar usulan. Opsi lowongan pemula hilang di semua sektor melebarkan klaim teks, yang cuma menyebut “several sectors” dan “at least three professions”. Opsi membela kerja tanpa upah persis kebalikan sikap makalahnya.

qs: What did the survey find about the 340 placements?
that most of them lasted for longer than a period of four weeks
that almost two thirds of them came with no payment attached
that a third of them came from firms with fewer than twenty staff
that the inspectorate had already visited most of the workplaces

qs.evidence: A survey of 340 placements advertised over six months found that 62 per cent offered no payment of any kind.
qs.answer: that almost two thirds of them came with no payment attached
qs.why: Survei menemukan 62 persen penempatan itu tanpa bayaran sama sekali.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sebagian besar lebih dari empat pekan mengambil angka dari ketentuan usulan, bukan dari temuan survei. Opsi sepertiga dari perusahaan kecil menempelkan sepertiga yang di teks menggambarkan tugas setara pegawai junior. Opsi pengawas sudah berkunjung memakai bagian keempat usulan sebagai hasil survei.

qs: Which finding is used to answer the fear that payment would reduce opportunities?
Elsewhere, compulsory wages left the volume of such posts unchanged.
A third of placements involved duties like those of a junior employee.
Unpaid placements are affordable only to graduates supported by family.
The inspectorate can add placement records to a checklist it already uses.

qs.evidence: Two sectors elsewhere in the region adopted mandatory payment and saw no reduction in the number of placements offered.
qs.answer: Elsewhere, compulsory wages left the volume of such posts unchanged.
qs.why: Dua sektor yang mewajibkan bayaran tidak mengalami penurunan jumlah penempatan yang ditawarkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tugas setara pegawai junior menunjukkan penyalahgunaannya, bukan bahwa peluang tetap ada setelah upah diwajibkan. Opsi hanya terjangkau bagi yang ditanggung keluarga adalah inti keberatannya, jadi ia soal keadilan, bukan jumlah lowongan. Opsi pengawas menambah daftar periksa menjawab biaya penegakan, bukan kekhawatiran peluang menyusut.

qs: What does the paper imply by describing a hiring channel as inheritance?
that firms prefer to recruit the relatives of their existing staff
that placements are handed down from one graduate to the next one
that a profession is entered by those whose family can support them
that employers inherit the records kept by the previous inspectorate

qs.evidence: An unpaid placement is affordable to a graduate whose family can house and feed her, and unaffordable to everybody else, so a hiring channel quietly becomes a form of inheritance.
qs.answer: that a profession is entered by those whose family can support them
qs.why: Maksudnya jalur masuk profesi jatuh ke orang yang keluarganya sanggup menanggung hidupnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi merekrut kerabat staf adalah nepotisme, arti “inheritance” yang paling menggoda tapi bukan yang dipakai teks. Opsi penempatan diwariskan antar lulusan menerjemahkan kiasannya secara harfiah. Opsi mewarisi arsip pengawas memindahkan kata itu ke bagian penegakan yang sama sekali lain urusannya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The proposal would allow employers with fewer than twenty staff to pay a lower rate at first."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The proposal would allow employers with fewer than twenty staff to pay a lower rate at first.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Small firms may withdraw from the scheme altogether, so a reduced rate for the first eight weeks is included for employers below twenty staff.
qs.why: Ada tarif lebih rendah untuk delapan minggu pertama bagi pemberi kerja di bawah dua puluh staf.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena keringanan itu ada; "Not stated" salah karena angka dan jangka waktunya ditulis.

topic: Regulating unpaid internships and informal apprenticeships
author: A labour policy analyst advising a ministry committee
setting: Policy paper prepared for a labour ministry committee

title: Why the Report Went Outside
text:
This review examines why staff here report wrongdoing to journalists before they report it internally. Of the eleven substantiated cases in the last four years, nine reached management through an external route. Exit interviews supply the explanation without much ambiguity. Staff did not believe the internal channel was confidential, and several could name a colleague whose career had ended shortly after using it. Reputational memory of that sort outlasts any procedural assurance an employer is able to print.

The existing procedure is defective in its design rather than in its administration. A report goes first to the line manager, which is of no use whatever when the line manager is the subject of it. The form then requires the name of the person reporting before it requires the substance of the report. Anonymity is promised in a paragraph and impossible in practice, since a description of the incident normally identifies its only witness. Confidentiality is therefore promised at precisely the point where the organization is least able to deliver it.

Three changes are therefore proposed. Reports should go to a committee including one member from outside the organization, and never to the reporter's own line of management. A written acknowledgement, carrying a case number and a stated timetable, should be issued within five working days. Any adverse change in the reporter's duties within the following year should be reviewed automatically by that committee, whether or not a complaint has been made. Automatic scrutiny converts an allegation of retaliation into an administrative obligation upon the manager concerned.

None of this eliminates the risk of retaliation, and pretending otherwise would repeat the mistake being corrected. What it does is transfer the burden of explanation onto the organization. A transfer which follows a report will have to be justified, and a manager unable to justify one will be seen to have failed. Justification, unlike secrecy, is a requirement an institution can genuinely enforce upon itself. That is a smaller promise than confidentiality, yet it is also a promise that can actually be kept.
qs: What is the main purpose of this review?
To count how many cases were substantiated over the past four years
To redesign an internal reporting route that staff do not trust
To criticize the journalists who published the disclosures received
To defend the rule that reports go first to the line manager

qs.evidence: The existing procedure is defective in its design rather than in its administration.
qs.answer: To redesign an internal reporting route that staff do not trust
qs.why: Tujuannya merancang ulang jalur pelaporan internal yang tidak dipercaya staf.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menghitung kasus memakai angka sebelas kasus sebagai tujuan, padahal angka itu pembuka diagnosis. Opsi menyalahkan jurnalis mengarang sasaran; teks menyalahkan rancangan prosedurnya. Opsi membela aturan lapor ke atasan langsung dibantah kalimat bahwa jalur itu “of no use whatever when the line manager is the subject of it”.

qs: What did the exit interviews reveal?
that most reports had been resolved within five working days of arrival
that nine of the eleven cases had been dismissed without any inquiry
that staff doubted confidentiality and knew of a ruined career
that managers preferred reports in writing rather than in person

qs.evidence: Staff did not believe the internal channel was confidential, and several could name a colleague whose career had ended shortly after using it.
qs.answer: that staff doubted confidentiality and knew of a ruined career
qs.why: Wawancara keluar menunjukkan staf tak yakin kerahasiaannya dan tahu ada karier yang tamat setelah melapor.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi selesai dalam lima hari kerja mengambil tenggat dari usulan perubahan, bukan dari temuan wawancara. Opsi sembilan kasus ditolak tanpa penyelidikan memelintir angkanya: sembilan kasus itu sampai ke manajemen lewat jalur luar dan terbukti. Opsi manajer lebih suka laporan tertulis menambah preferensi yang nggak pernah disebut.

qs: Which observation is offered as evidence that the promise of anonymity fails?
Nine of the eleven cases probably arrived by an external route.
A written acknowledgement is usually issued within five working days.
An account of the incident usually points to its only witness.
One member of the proposed committee comes from outside the firm.

qs.evidence: Anonymity is promised in a paragraph and impossible in practice, since a description of the incident normally identifies its only witness.
qs.answer: An account of the incident usually points to its only witness.
qs.why: Uraian kejadiannya sendiri biasanya menunjuk satu-satunya saksi, jadi janji anonim itu kosong.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sembilan dari sebelas kasus menjelaskan kenapa orang memilih jalur luar, bukan kenapa anonimitas mustahil. Opsi surat tanda terima dan opsi anggota komite dari luar dua-duanya bagian usulan perbaikan, jadi keduanya obat, bukan bukti kegagalan janji anonim.

qs: What can be inferred about the automatic review of a reporter's duties?
It should prevent the committee from taking in any external members.
It should remove the need for a written acknowledgement altogether.
It should speed up the investigation of the original report itself.
It should make a manager account for a change that looks punitive.

qs.evidence: A transfer which follows a report will have to be justified, and a manager unable to justify one will be seen to have failed.
qs.answer: It should make a manager account for a change that looks punitive.
qs.why: Telaah otomatis itu memaksa manajer menjelaskan perubahan tugas yang tampak sebagai pembalasan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menghalangi anggota luar bertentangan dengan usulan pertama, yang justru menuntut satu anggota dari luar. Opsi menghapus surat tanda terima menabrak usulan kedua yang berjalan bersamaan. Opsi mempercepat penyelidikan menukar sasarannya, karena telaah otomatis mengurus perubahan tugas pelapor setelah laporan, bukan kecepatan pemeriksaan laporannya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The review recommends that the outside member of the committee be chosen by the staff."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The review recommends that the outside member of the committee be chosen by the staff.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Reports should go to a committee including one member from outside the organization, and never to the reporter's own line of management.
qs.why: Teks cuma menyebut ada satu anggota dari luar; siapa yang memilihnya sama sekali tidak diatur.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" dan "False" sama-sama menuntut keterangan cara pemilihan yang tidak pernah ada di teks.

topic: Redesigning an internal channel for reporting wrongdoing
author: A governance adviser reviewing internal reporting procedures
setting: Internal review prepared for an organization's audit committee

title: The Arithmetic of Reading
text:
Every January the same ritual resumes, and the choreography never varies by so much as a step. Somebody publishes a photograph of an alarming tower of unread volumes and announces, with the serenity of a person reciting a grocery list, that this year's quota is one hundred titles. The replies arrive scented with admiration, congratulating an achievement that has not yet happened. Nobody poses the awkward question, which concerns what those hundred volumes accomplished inside the reader, or whether a single one deserved an entire winter to itself.

I harbour no objection to counting, and statistics are honest in a manner that opinions seldom manage. Anyone who genuinely absorbs fifty volumes has clearly spent their evenings somewhere other than a glowing rectangle. What unsettles me is the quiet migration from reading as appetite towards reading as a scoreboard with witnesses. Once a novel becomes a unit of production, the rational manoeuvre is to select brief ones, obliging ones, volumes that surrender their significance on a first careless pass. The reading challenge, that amiable little contest, therefore rewards the precise habits it was invented to cure.

The vocabulary betrays the shift more reliably than any confession would. Acquaintances describe getting through a novel, demolishing it, clearing the shelf, as though literature belonged to the same weary category as household administration. Nobody admits to inhabiting a book any more, and the older expressions for that condition have drifted quietly out of fashion. With them went an entire disposition, one that treated a difficult text as an opponent capable of answering back. A volume you have merely completed cannot argue with anybody; it has been processed and filed.

None of this is anybody's particular fault, which is exactly why the remedy remains so elusive. Our counting culture emerged from a thoroughly decent instinct, the desire to construct a habit, and habits do require modest visible victories. The trouble is that the victories have quietly become the destination rather than the road. An acquaintance of mine, a subtle and unhurried reader, confided last spring that she had abandoned a demanding biography because it was damaging her monthly average. She laughed while confessing it, and I laughed as well, then wandered home feeling obscurely bruised. I understood her reasoning exactly, having performed that very retreat twice inside a fortnight.

So here is a proposal, offered without a single diagram or downloadable template. Preserve the inventory if the inventory sustains you, but append a second column, the one enquiring what each volume actually altered. Most entries will remain gloriously empty, and the emptiness is the honest measurement. It is also, conveniently, the only measurement nobody has yet contrived a method of publishing.
qs: What is the central argument of this essay?
Habit-building schemes work best when readers publish their monthly totals for others to see.
The language readers use about novels has coarsened, and that shift matters more than any target.
Turning books into a countable target quietly encourages the shallow reading it was meant to fix.
Counting is a decent instinct that mainly needs a more accurate way of recording pages.

qs.evidence: The reading challenge, that amiable little contest, therefore rewards the precise habits it was invented to cure.
qs.answer: Turning books into a countable target quietly encourages the shallow reading it was meant to fix.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya menyatakan lomba baca memberi hadiah pada kebiasaan yang justru mau disembuhkannya, jadi target angka mendorong bacaan serba cepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menerbitkan total bulanan justru praktik yang penulis kritik, bukan resepnya; opsi pergeseran kosakata memang ada di paragraf tiga tetapi dipakai sebagai bukti, bukan gagasan utama; opsi mencatat halaman lebih akurat salah karena keberatan penulis bukan pada ketepatan angka melainkan pada angka yang menjadi tujuan.

qs: What does the acquaintance's decision about the biography suggest?
Readers with monthly targets tend to abandon long books towards the end of the year.
Her monthly average recovered as soon as she replaced the biography with shorter titles.
She kept her tally but treated the abandoned biography as evidence against the whole habit.
Keeping her tally intact had begun to outrank her own taste in books.

qs.evidence: An acquaintance of mine, a subtle and unhurried reader, confided last spring that she had abandoned a demanding biography because it was damaging her monthly average.
qs.answer: Keeping her tally intact had begun to outrank her own taste in books.
qs.why: Alasan yang dia sebutkan bukan buku yang sulit melainkan rata-rata bulanannya yang rusak, jadi skor sudah mengalahkan seleranya sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi akhir tahun memindahkan waktunya, sebab teks menyebut kejadiannya musim semi lalu; opsi rata-rata pulih menambahkan akibat yang tidak dilaporkan teks; opsi bukti melawan kebiasaan bertentangan dengan sikapnya, karena dia justru menertawakannya dan penulis mengaku melakukan hal yang sama.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the replies that greet these January announcements?
Wearily nostalgic for a time when finishing a book needed no announcement.
Measured and neutral, simply recording how such replies are usually written.
Guardedly sympathetic towards readers who look for encouragement in public.
Quietly mocking, since the praise is handed out before anything has been done.

qs.evidence: The replies arrive scented with admiration, congratulating an achievement that has not yet happened.
qs.answer: Quietly mocking, since the praise is handed out before anything has been done.
qs.why: Frasa “scented with admiration” ditambah pujian untuk pencapaian yang belum terjadi menandai sindiran halus, bukan laporan datar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi nostalgia keliru karena penulis tidak merindukan masa lalu, dia menyoroti mekanisme skor yang berjalan sekarang; opsi netral mengabaikan pilihan kata yang jelas menilai; opsi simpati terbimbing salah arah karena yang dia soroti adalah pujian yang belum berdasar, bukan kebutuhan pembaca akan dukungan.

qs: In the third paragraph, what does "processed and filed" suggest about such a book?
It has been shelved carefully so that the reader can argue with it later.
It was read slowly enough for the novel to answer back.
It has been handled like an errand instead of engaged as a voice.
It has been recommended to other readers who keep long lists of volumes.

qs.evidence: A volume you have merely completed cannot argue with anybody; it has been processed and filed.
qs.answer: It has been handled like an errand instead of engaged as a voice.
qs.why: Dua kata itu bahasa administrasi: bukunya diselesaikan sebagai urusan yang harus dibereskan, bukan diajak berdebat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi disimpan rapi agar bisa dibantah nanti bertentangan dengan “cannot argue with anybody”; opsi dibaca lambat sampai novelnya membalas bertentangan dengan gagasan buku yang sekadar diproses dan difailkan; opsi direkomendasikan ke pembaca lain memakai detail daftar dari paragraf lain yang tidak menjelaskan kiasan itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer admits abandoning a book himself to keep his reading figures healthy."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer admits abandoning a book himself to keep his reading figures healthy.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I understood her reasoning exactly, having performed that very retreat twice inside a fortnight.
qs.why: “that very retreat” merujuk pada tindakan yang sama seperti kenalannya, yaitu meninggalkan buku demi angka. Jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” tidak bisa dipakai karena teks mengakuinya terang-terangan, dan “Not stated” gagal karena buktinya ada di kalimat penutup paragraf empat.

topic: reading challenges and the counting of books
author: Devi Ramaputra
setting: a critical essay on annual reading targets

title: Eight Pounds for Certainty
text:
The audio guide is presented at the entrance with the warmth of a nurse handing out medicine, and refusal would feel faintly arrogant. Within ninety seconds a velvet voice has established that the woman in the portrait is enigmatic and that her gaze pursues you around the room. The artist, we learn, was of course misunderstood throughout his lifetime. You look up obediently, the gaze does appear to pursue you, and something within the transaction has nevertheless gone quietly wrong.

My objection concerns neither information nor research, which galleries dispense too sparingly rather than too generously, but the smuggling of finished verdicts inside apparently polite descriptions. When the narrator declares that a brushstroke conveys unbearable tenderness, the visitor is no longer looking at a painting. The visitor is auditing a claim, and scarcely any of us possess the nerve to return a verdict of not proven. The commentary carries an entire institution behind it, so disagreement rapidly begins to resemble vandalism.

Consider what an unhurried encounter genuinely demands: several minutes of pure discomfort, during which the image withholds its meaning entirely. You begin suspecting your own dullness, and that suspicion is not an obstacle to appreciation but appreciation itself, in its earliest and least flattering stage. The audio guide abolishes the discomfort within a minute, then charges eight pounds for the abolition. Visitors emerge convinced they have been educated when they have in fact merely been soothed.

Curators understand this perfectly, which explains why the braver institutions now experiment with silence, unlabelled walls, and captions appearing only after a deliberate delay. My local gallery attempted such a scheme two autumns ago throughout its Renaissance wing. Attendance dipped, complaints multiplied, and a councillor denounced the initiative as elitist, his reasoning being that ordinary people cannot tolerate an unexplained painting. The wing was restored to its former talkative condition within a single season, and the councillor was thanked publicly.

I still accept the headphones occasionally, usually when exhausted, and never quite forgive myself afterwards. A particular flatness accompanies leaving an exhibition having agreed with absolutely everything, rather like the aftermath of a comfortable conversation in which nobody said anything true. The guide is not the villain of this narrative; it is merely the symptom of an older surrender. Somewhere along the way we concluded that looking was a skill requiring supervision, and we have been paying rental fees for the use of our own eyes ever since.
qs: How does the writer relate early discomfort to appreciation?
The unease fades once a visitor has seen enough paintings to trust their own eye.
Appreciation comes first, and the unease arrives only when the commentary stops.
The unease is the first stage of appreciation rather than something blocking it.
The commentary dissolves the unease, which is why most visitors accept the headphones.

qs.evidence: You begin suspecting your own dullness, and that suspicion is not an obstacle to appreciation but appreciation itself, in its earliest and least flattering stage.
qs.answer: The unease is the first stage of appreciation rather than something blocking it.
qs.why: Teks menolak anggapan bahwa rasa tumpul itu penghalang: rasa itu disebut sebagai tahap paling awal dan paling tidak menyenangkan dari apresiasi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi rasa tidak nyaman memudar seiring pengalaman menambahkan perkembangan yang tidak ada di teks; opsi urutan terbalik menukar dua hal yang justru disebut satu hal yang sama; opsi panduan melarutkan rasa itu keliru karena teks menyebut panduan memberi putusan siap pakai, bukan menyembuhkan keraguan.

qs: What can be inferred about the councillor's assumption?
He was mainly worried that attendance would not recover before the season ended.
He believed the labels had been withdrawn in order to reduce the gallery's costs.
He thought most visitors would prefer longer captions to a rented audio guide.
He assumed unexplained art is bearable only for a privileged audience.

qs.evidence: Attendance dipped, complaints multiplied, and a councillor denounced the initiative as elitist, his reasoning being that ordinary people cannot tolerate an unexplained painting.
qs.answer: He assumed unexplained art is bearable only for a privileged audience.
qs.why: Alasan yang dikutip teks adalah keyakinan bahwa orang biasa tidak tahan lukisan tanpa penjelasan, sehingga menikmati tanpa panduan dianggap milik kalangan tertentu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kekhawatiran soal kunjungan memakai fakta “attendance dipped” tetapi bukan alasan yang dinyatakan teks; opsi penghematan biaya menambahkan motif yang tidak pernah disebut; opsi kapsi lebih panjang tidak didukung, karena keberatannya soal ketiadaan penjelasan, bukan soal bentuknya.

qs: What does the comparison with a nurse handing out medicine reveal about the writer's view of the offer?
He finds the kindness mildly coercive, since refusing looks like bad manners.
He is quietly grateful that the gallery anticipates how lost a visitor can feel.
He is drily neutral about a routine that the entrance staff repeat all day.
He is faintly embarrassed at having accepted the headphones so readily himself.

qs.evidence: The audio guide is presented at the entrance with the warmth of a nurse handing out medicine, and refusal would feel faintly arrogant.
qs.answer: He finds the kindness mildly coercive, since refusing looks like bad manners.
qs.why: Kehangatan di situ menekan: menolak jadi terasa sombong, sehingga tawaran yang ramah bekerja sebagai paksaan halus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi bersyukur mengabaikan ironi pada perbandingan dengan perawat yang membagikan obat; opsi netral kering bertabrakan dengan seluruh keberatan penulis pada panduan itu; opsi malu pada dirinya sendiri menambahkan pengakuan yang tidak ada, sebab teks bicara soal bagaimana penolakan akan terasa.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the closing image about rental fees?
Galleries recover the cost of the equipment from the visitors who need it most.
Looking at pictures has grown cheaper since the commentary became optional.
We now pay other people for permission to trust what we see.
Visitors who hire the guide see more of an exhibition than those who decline.

qs.evidence: Somewhere along the way we concluded that looking was a skill requiring supervision, and we have been paying rental fees for the use of our own eyes ever since.
qs.answer: We now pay other people for permission to trust what we see.
qs.why: Menyewa mata sendiri berarti hak menilai diserahkan ke pihak lain dan kita membayar untuk izin itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi memulihkan biaya alat dan opsi jadi lebih murah membaca kiasan sewa sebagai urusan tarif; opsi penyewa panduan melihat lebih banyak bertentangan dengan seluruh argumen teks bahwa panduan menggantikan penglihatan sendiri.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer refuses the headphones on every visit he makes."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer refuses the headphones on every visit he makes.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I still accept the headphones occasionally, usually when exhausted, and never quite forgive myself afterwards.
qs.why: Teks bilang dia kadang masih memakainya, terutama saat lelah. Jadi klaim “selalu menolak” bertentangan langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kata “occasionally”, dan “Not stated” tidak berlaku karena kebiasaannya disebut eksplisit.

topic: museum audio guides and how visitors look at art
author: Halim Prasetyo
setting: a critical essay on gallery interpretation

title: Protect Your Streak
text:
The tidiest confession of our decade is buried in the vocabulary of productivity software, which no longer bothers pretending to be neutral machinery. Applications now congratulate you, gently reprimand you, and enquire whether you would like to protect your streak, a phrase borrowed intact from the language of moral character. My calendar recently informed me that I had reclaimed four hours, as though the hours had been kidnapped and I had negotiated brilliantly for their release.

There is nothing sinister in wanting an ordered week, and I say that as somebody who owns three notebooks devoted to the ambition. The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience attached to it. Where a wasted afternoon once counted as a mild embarrassment, it now registers as a lapse against an agreement you signed with an interface. Guilt has been outsourced to a dashboard, which performs the accounting with a cheerfulness no human supervisor would dare imitate.

Observe the grammar of the notifications themselves, because the grammar is precisely where the argument conceals itself. Nobody is ever informed that a target was unrealistic. The phrasing insists instead that momentum was lost, which locates the failure inside the user rather than inside the plan. The software cannot be wrong about your priorities, since it merely records the priorities you typed at eleven o'clock on a Sunday evening while feeling unusually ambitious. That version of you is treated as the authoritative witness, and the exhausted Wednesday version has no right of appeal.

The consequences are subtle rather than tragic, which is precisely why they persist unexamined. Tasks that resist measurement, such as thinking without a deliverable or sitting with a predicament until it changes shape, quietly migrate to the bottom of every list. An engineer I interviewed described deleting his reading time from the system because it kept appearing as an unproductive block. He still reads, he assured me, though secretly, in the manner of a man smuggling contraband past his own border guards.

I would not abolish these instruments, partly because abolition never works and partly because mine has genuinely rescued several deadlines. I would simply like the tone adjusted downwards, from moral tutor to competent clerk. A clerk records what occurred and declines to comment; a tutor decides who you are becoming. We handed a filing system the second occupation without noticing, and it has been diligently issuing verdicts on our characters ever since, one encouraging notification at a time.
qs: What is the main point of this essay?
Planning software measures effort more honestly than the people using it do.
An ordered week depends less on the tool chosen than on the habits behind it.
Planning software has begun passing moral judgement on the people using it.
Planning software keeps a neutral record, and any guilt the user feels is their own.

qs.evidence: The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience attached to it.
qs.answer: Planning software has begun passing moral judgement on the people using it.
qs.why: Kalimat “efficiency has acquired a conscience attached to it” adalah intinya: alat jadwal kini menilai baik-buruk penggunanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi mengukur usaha lebih jujur bertentangan dengan paragraf yang menyebut alat itu tidak dapat mengukur waktu berpikir; opsi soal kebiasaan adalah nasihat umum yang tidak diklaim teks; opsi catatan netral persis anggapan yang dibantah teks pada kalimat pertama.

qs: What can be inferred about how the software treats your typed priorities?
It weights the tasks you repeat most often above the ones you typed on Sunday.
It compares the Sunday plan with what you actually did and adjusts the target.
It sets aside priorities that the week has plainly overtaken.
It quietly treats an over-optimistic mood as your real intention.

qs.evidence: The software cannot be wrong about your priorities, since it merely records the priorities you typed at eleven o'clock on a Sunday evening while feeling unusually ambitious.
qs.answer: It quietly treats an over-optimistic mood as your real intention.
qs.why: Versi dirimu yang sedang bersemangat pada Minggu malam dijadikan patokan resmi, padahal itu suasana hati sesaat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menimbang tugas yang sering diulang menambahkan mekanisme yang tidak disebut; opsi membandingkan rencana dengan hasil bertentangan dengan “cannot be wrong about your priorities”; opsi menyisihkan prioritas yang sudah usang membalik kata “merely records”.

qs: What is the writer's tone when he describes the message about reclaimed hours?
Mildly impressed by wording that makes a small saving feel like an achievement.
Measured, treating the notification as a harmless piece of company style.
Faintly uneasy that four hours of his working week had gone missing unnoticed.
Amused at wording that dresses a small saving as a daring rescue.

qs.evidence: My calendar recently informed me that I had reclaimed four hours, as though the hours had been kidnapped and I had negotiated brilliantly for their release.
qs.answer: Amused at wording that dresses a small saving as a daring rescue.
qs.why: Kiasan penyanderaan dan negosiasi brilian itu lelucon kering: dia menertawakan bahasa yang membesar-besarkan penghematan kecil.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi terkesan salah arah karena kiasannya dikutip untuk ditertawakan; opsi netral mengabaikan pilihan katanya sendiri; opsi cemas membaca kiasan penyanderaan secara harfiah, padahal teks tidak menyatakan jamnya benar-benar hilang.

qs: What does the phrase "protect your streak" bring into the software?
A sense of personal virtue that has nothing to do with scheduling.
A steady count of days that says nothing about the person keeping it.
A reminder that habits kept unbroken are the ones most likely to last.
A setting that preserves your records after a week has been abandoned.

qs.evidence: Applications now congratulate you, gently reprimand you, and enquire whether you would like to protect your streak, a phrase borrowed intact from the language of moral character.
qs.answer: A sense of personal virtue that has nothing to do with scheduling.
qs.why: Teks menyebut frasa itu dipinjam utuh dari bahasa watak moral, jadi yang masuk ke aplikasi adalah urusan baik-buruk pribadi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi hitungan hari yang netral menolak kata “moral character”; opsi pengingat soal kebiasaan adalah klaim psikologi umum yang tidak diambil teks; opsi setelan penyimpanan membaca frasa itu sebagai fitur teknis.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Fewer than half of the engineer's colleagues deleted their reading time from the system."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Fewer than half of the engineer's colleagues deleted their reading time from the system.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: An engineer I interviewed described deleting his reading time from the system because it kept appearing as an unproductive block.
qs.why: Teks cuma bercerita tentang satu insinyur. Tidak ada angka apa pun soal rekan kerjanya, jadi jumlahnya tidak bisa dinilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” dan “False” sama-sama butuh data jumlah yang tidak pernah ditulis; kalimat terdekat hanya menyebut satu orang.

topic: the moral tone of productivity software
author: Yusra Kaltsum
setting: a critical essay on self-tracking applications

title: The Ruin That Never Arrives
text:
Every generation discovers, with the delight of an archaeologist digging up an old secret, that the language is in decline. The evidence is submitted promptly and invariably consists of teenagers. They abbreviate, they invent verbs from nouns, they deploy literally in ways that would appal a lexicographer of 1890, and civilisation is accordingly presumed to be sliding gently into the sea. The complaint is as old as writing itself, and its persistence ought to make the complainers suspicious, though it rarely does.

I confess a certain tenderness towards the pedants, having belonged to that little club throughout my twenties. Precision furnishes a genuine pleasure, and whoever distinguishes scrupulously between imply and infer is defending something worth preserving. The difficulty is that the defence is invariably aimed at the wrong target. Nobody polices the vocabulary of consultants, whose sentences absorb an entire paragraph without depositing a single clear notion, yet a teenager writing gonna to a companion attracts the full attention of the nation.

Consider what the complaint actually protects, once the decorative outrage has been stripped away. Standards of usage operate as a filter, and filters are wonderfully convenient for whoever already belongs inside. When an interview panel dismisses a candidate for saying between you and I, the panel is not mourning a grammatical error. It is recognizing an accent and discreetly declining to admit it. The rules are genuine, the enforcement is selective, and the selection follows the lines of class with an accuracy no linguist could improve upon.

Meanwhile the language pursues its usual business, which is to change in the mouths of the youthful and be pronounced dead by the middle-aged. Words narrow, widen, sour and sweeten, and no petitions are circulated. Nice formerly meant foolish, awful formerly meant deserving of awe, and no farewell speeches whatever were delivered when the meanings migrated. Our own innovations will one day be defended fiercely by descendants who currently find them intolerable, which is perhaps the single reliable law of the discipline.

So by all means practise your semicolons, and correct your own drafts until the sentences behave themselves. What I would surrender is the pleasure of correcting strangers, a hobby that has never improved one sentence written by anybody else. Language is not a monument requiring uniformed guards; it is a market, noisy and honest, where usefulness eventually outbids etiquette. The pedants will lose, as they always have, and they will lose in beautifully constructed prose.
qs: How does the writer relate the rules of usage to the way they are enforced?
He treats the rules as inventions and the enforcement as the only real thing.
He accepts the rules as real but says enforcement follows social lines.
He accepts both the rules and the enforcement, and blames only careless writers.
He doubts the rules yet concedes that enforcement is applied evenly enough.

qs.evidence: The rules are genuine, the enforcement is selective, and the selection follows the lines of class with an accuracy no linguist could improve upon.
qs.answer: He accepts the rules as real but says enforcement follows social lines.
qs.why: Teks menyebut aturannya “genuine” dan penerapannya “selective”, dan seleksinya mengikuti garis kelas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi aturan sebagai rekaan membalik kata “genuine”; opsi menerima keduanya menghapus keberatan pada penerapannya; opsi penerapan merata bertentangan langsung dengan kata “selective”.

qs: What does the contrast between consultants and teenagers imply?
Consultants escape criticism because their sentences obey the rules more closely.
Teenagers are corrected because abbreviation genuinely obscures what they mean.
Complaints about usage tend to fade once the offending forms become common.
Complaints about language track who speaks, not how clearly they speak.

qs.evidence: Nobody polices the vocabulary of consultants, whose sentences absorb an entire paragraph without depositing a single clear notion, yet a teenager writing gonna to a companion attracts the full attention of the nation.
qs.answer: Complaints about language track who speaks, not how clearly they speak.
qs.why: Prosa konsultan yang tidak menyampaikan gagasan dibiarkan, sedangkan satu kata remaja menarik perhatian nasional; jadi yang menentukan adalah siapa yang bicara.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi konsultan lebih patuh aturan tidak didukung, karena teks justru menyoroti kalimat mereka yang kosong; opsi singkatan mengaburkan makna bertentangan dengan contoh gonna yang maksudnya jelas; opsi keluhan mereda seiring waktu adalah klaim umum yang tidak dibahas teks.

qs: What attitude does the final sentence convey towards the pedants?
Grudgingly respectful of people who defend the rules better than he could.
Resigned, since the same argument returns in every generation without moving.
Affectionate teasing of people he expects to lose anyway.
Quietly regretful that careful prose now has so few public defenders.

qs.evidence: The pedants will lose, as they always have, and they will lose in beautifully constructed prose.
qs.answer: Affectionate teasing of people he expects to lose anyway.
qs.why: Dia meramalkan mereka kalah tetapi memuji prosanya dalam kalimat yang sama, dan itu ledekan yang bersahabat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi hormat setengah hati mengabaikan ramalan kalah yang jelas; opsi resignasi menambahkan keputusasaan yang tidak ada, sebab dia justru menyebut hasilnya sudah pasti; opsi menyesal kehilangan pembela bertentangan dengan sikapnya yang menganggap perubahan bahasa wajar.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the image of the market in the final paragraph?
A market needs supervision, and a shared language needs it just as much.
Speakers settle usage by what works, not by what good manners prescribe.
Usage shifts slowly, because politeness outlasts most fashions in speech.
Monuments and markets alike need guards if they are going to survive.

qs.evidence: Language is not a monument requiring uniformed guards; it is a market, noisy and honest, where usefulness eventually outbids etiquette.
qs.answer: Speakers settle usage by what works, not by what good manners prescribe.
qs.why: Kiasan pasar berarti pemakaian ditentukan oleh kegunaan, yang pada akhirnya mengalahkan etiket.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pasar perlu pengawasan dan opsi penjaga mengabaikan penolakan tegas pada kiasan monumen berpenjaga; opsi kesopanan lebih tahan lama membalik kata “usefulness eventually outbids etiquette”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer once belonged to the group of language correctors himself."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer once belonged to the group of language correctors himself.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I confess a certain tenderness towards the pedants, having belonged to that little club throughout my twenties.
qs.why: “That little club” itu para pedan, dan dia mengaku pernah ikut sepanjang usia dua puluhan. Klaimnya parafrasa yang tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan pengakuannya sendiri, dan “Not stated” gagal karena kalimatnya jelas ada di paragraf dua.

topic: complaints about grammar and language change
author: Nadira Amsyar
setting: a critical essay on linguistic pedantry

title: The Overworked Adjective
text:
The adjective authentic has been labouring overtime for a decade, and it now displays unmistakable symptoms of exhaustion. It decorates the menus of restaurants with exposed brickwork and packets of biscuits manufactured in industrial quantities. It hangs above a coffee bar near my office whose sacks bear the name of a village nobody on the premises could locate on a map. Everything is authentic, and consequently nothing whatever is anything in particular.

The transformation deserves tracing, because cynicism alone did not accomplish it, and twenty years ago the word conveyed genuine information. It distinguished the cook who inherited a recipe from her grandmother from the factory that approximated the result with flavourings. Consumers desired the distinction, and the market, ever obliging, supplied the vocabulary instead of the substance. Once a word begins selling merchandise its meaning becomes a cost to be reduced, and reduction continues until the label may be attached to almost anything without provoking laughter.

What interests me is the identity of whoever eventually pays for the arrangement. The cook whose family actually preserved the recipe now competes against a chain that purchased her adjective wholesale, and she cannot readily complain, since the adjective was never hers to register. She raises her prices to signal quality, which makes her appear expensive, while the chain lowers its prices and consequently appears generous. Customers depart persuaded that they have supported tradition, and the arithmetic quietly favours whoever owns the printing press.

A subtler indignity accompanies the commercial one, and no legislation has yet been drafted against it. Communities begin performing versions of themselves that visitors will accept as genuine, which is a peculiar assignment to receive. A friend who runs a modest kitchen in Yogyakarta recently withdrew a dish her family had eaten for generations, because tourists complained repeatedly that it did not taste traditional enough. The dish was traditional; it simply failed to resemble what the guidebooks had promised, and those guidebooks had been printed in enormous quantities.

I possess no elegant remedy, and I distrust essays that arrive brandishing one. I have nevertheless retired the word from my own vocabulary, which costs nothing and clarifies a surprising amount. Enquire instead who cooked the food, who received the money, and how long the establishment has occupied that particular corner. The answers are dull, specific and extremely difficult to counterfeit, and dullness of that kind is the nearest approximation to a guarantee that any of us will obtain.
qs: What is the main argument of this essay?
A label used in advertising acquires a narrower meaning than the word it replaces.
Cooks who defend a traditional dish usually lose their customers to larger chains.
A term used to sell goods loses precision until it fits nearly any product.
Buyers learn to distrust flattering labels, which is why such labels keep changing.

qs.evidence: Once a word begins selling merchandise its meaning becomes a cost to be reduced, and reduction continues until the label may be attached to almost anything without provoking laughter.
qs.answer: A term used to sell goods loses precision until it fits nearly any product.
qs.why: Begitu sebuah kata dipakai berjualan, maknanya menjadi biaya yang terus dipotong sampai label itu bisa ditempel ke apa saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi makna makin sempit membalik arah kalimat kuncinya, sebab teks menyebut maknanya menipis sampai bisa dipakai untuk apa pun; opsi juru masak kehilangan pelanggan memakai contoh Yogyakarta yang di teks berakhir dengan penarikan hidangan; opsi pembeli belajar meragukan label bertentangan dengan teks, yang menyebut label itu tetap dipakai tanpa memancing tawa.

qs: What can be inferred from the two pricing moves described in the third paragraph?
The signals get read backwards, so the honest cook looks like the greedy one.
Customers compare the two prices and generally reward the smaller kitchen.
Higher prices persuade most buyers that the ingredients must be better.
The chain can lower its prices because its costs are genuinely lower than hers.

qs.evidence: She raises her prices to signal quality, which makes her appear expensive, while the chain lowers its prices and consequently appears generous.
qs.answer: The signals get read backwards, so the honest cook looks like the greedy one.
qs.why: Sinyal harganya terbaca terbalik: yang menaikkan harga demi mutu tampak mahal, sedangkan yang menurunkan harga tampak baik hati.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pembeli memihak dapur kecil bertentangan dengan kalimat berikutnya; opsi harga tinggi meyakinkan pembeli membalik akibat yang ditulis, yaitu dia justru tampak mahal; opsi biaya jaringan lebih rendah menambahkan penjelasan ekonomi yang tidak ada di teks.

qs: What feeling does the writer convey through the story of the withdrawn dish?
Measured regret at a kitchen obliged to follow the taste of its customers.
Quiet outrage that outsiders now decide what counts as genuine cooking.
Wry sympathy for tourists unable to tell the traditional from the invented.
Guarded optimism that the dish will return once the fashion has passed.

qs.evidence: A friend who runs a modest kitchen in Yogyakarta recently withdrew a dish her family had eaten for generations, because tourists complained repeatedly that it did not taste traditional enough.
qs.answer: Quiet outrage that outsiders now decide what counts as genuine cooking.
qs.why: Hidangan yang dimakan keluarga itu selama beberapa generasi ditarik karena keluhan turis, dan teks menyebutnya justru tradisional; di situ ada kemarahan yang ditahan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penyesalan terukur meredakan penilaian teks yang menyebut keluhan turis salah; opsi simpati pada turis salah pihak karena mereka pihak yang menuntut; opsi optimisme berhati-hati menambahkan harapan yang tidak ada di paragraf itu.

qs: What does the writer mean by saying that everything is "authentic"?
Standards have risen far enough for the word to apply almost everywhere.
The label has spread so widely that it separates nothing from anything.
The word survives only where a dish can be traced to a single family.
Diners now use the word ironically, which is why menus have dropped it.

qs.evidence: Everything is authentic, and consequently nothing whatever is anything in particular.
qs.answer: The label has spread so widely that it separates nothing from anything.
qs.why: Kalau semua hal boleh memakai label itu, labelnya berhenti membedakan apa pun, sesuai kalimat “nothing whatever is anything in particular”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi standar naik membaca kalimatnya secara harfiah, padahal maksudnya labelnya kosong; opsi hanya berlaku bagi resep keluarga mempersempit ke contoh Yogyakarta; opsi menu berhenti memakai kata itu bertentangan dengan teks yang menyebut label itu masih dipakai di mana-mana.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer sets out a detailed plan for repairing the problem."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer sets out a detailed plan for repairing the problem.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I possess no elegant remedy, and I distrust essays that arrive brandishing one.
qs.why: Dia justru bilang tidak punya obat yang rapi dan curiga pada esai yang menawarkannya. Klaim ini bertolak belakang.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertentangan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena penulis menyatakan posisinya sendiri.

topic: how the word authentic lost its meaning in food marketing
author: Elang Wicaksana
setting: a critical essay on authenticity and commerce

title: Five Tired People in a Room
text:
The shortlist appears in October, and for a fortnight the entire literary economy behaves as though six novels had been selected by physics rather than by five tired individuals in a room above a bank. Sales multiply immediately, and booksellers construct elaborate pyramids beside the entrance. Interviewers enquire, with touching sincerity, what the shortlisting means to the author, and the author replies that awards are not the point, which is true and yet somehow said into a microphone.

I have judged a modest regional prize twice, so my scepticism is at least paid for by experience. The process is not corrupt; it is merely human, which is considerably more unpredictable. A book that nobody loves may survive because nobody hates it either, while the volume that split the panel down the middle dies of its own electricity. Compromise favours competence, and competence is the least interesting quality any novel can possess.

The genuine damage occurs afterwards, in the reading public rather than the panel. A prize does not merely reward a book; it abolishes several hundred others for the season, since attention is finite and shelves are not elastic. Publishers observe which qualities travelled well and commission accordingly, so the next few years arrive faintly perfumed with imitation. Nobody plans this. It emerges from a thousand reasonable decisions taken by employees protecting their livelihoods.

Defenders of the system reply that prizes create readers, and the reply deserves respect rather than mockery. Somebody who buys one shortlisted novel every autumn has a richer inner life than somebody who buys none, and I have never met a writer whose rent was paid by principle. The awkward truth is that both propositions hold simultaneously. Prizes widen the audience and narrow the field, and the second effect operates slowly enough to be denied by anybody who profits from the first.

What I would like is not abolition but modesty in the surrounding language. Announce the winner as the preference of five particular readers in a particular month, which is precisely what it is, and permit the losing novels to remain unfinished business rather than settled cases. The last time I served, we changed our minds three times in ninety minutes and then announced our verdict with the composure of a jury. Somebody in the audience wept audibly. I recall wondering whether she would have wept for our second preference, and concluding, uncomfortably, that she almost certainly would.
qs: Which statement best captures the writer's overall position?
Awards work better when panels are given considerably longer than ninety minutes.
Awards matter far less to sales than the publishers of shortlisted books claim.
Awards bring in more readers while quietly shrinking what gets written.
Awards reward competence, which is the quality most readers are actually after.

qs.evidence: Prizes widen the audience and narrow the field, and the second effect operates slowly enough to be denied by anybody who profits from the first.
qs.answer: Awards bring in more readers while quietly shrinking what gets written.
qs.why: Teks menyatakan penghargaan melebarkan pembaca dan menyempitkan ragam yang ditulis, dan akibat kedua berjalan cukup lambat untuk disangkal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi panel butuh waktu lebih lama memakai detail sembilan puluh menit sebagai usul reformasi yang tidak pernah diajukan teks; opsi penjualan tidak terpengaruh bertentangan dengan “sales multiply”; opsi kompetensi sebagai yang dicari pembaca membalik kalimat yang menyebut kompetensi kualitas paling tidak menarik.

qs: What can be inferred about the way panels arrive at a shortlist?
They tend to favour whichever novel the most senior judge argues for.
They settle on the titles that the panel has managed to finish in time.
They reward the book that splits the panel, since disagreement signals ambition.
They tend to eliminate the books that provoke the strongest reactions.

qs.evidence: A book that nobody loves may survive because nobody hates it either, while the volume that split the panel down the middle dies of its own electricity.
qs.answer: They tend to eliminate the books that provoke the strongest reactions.
qs.why: Buku yang tidak dibenci siapa pun bertahan, sedangkan buku yang membelah panel mati karena listriknya sendiri; jadi reaksi kuat merugikan sebuah novel.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi juri paling senior menambahkan mekanisme kekuasaan yang tidak disebut teks; opsi buku yang selesai dibaca memakai batas waktu dari paragraf lain yang tidak menjawab pertanyaan; opsi memilih buku yang membelah panel membalik kalimat kuncinya.

qs: What does the writer suggest by mentioning the composure of a jury?
That such panels reach their verdicts with something close to judicial care.
That a calm public front conceals a distinctly wobbly private process.
That ninety minutes is usually long enough to arrive at a fair decision.
That judges feel the weight of a verdict much as a court would.

qs.evidence: The last time I served, we changed our minds three times in ninety minutes and then announced our verdict with the composure of a jury.
qs.answer: That a calm public front conceals a distinctly wobbly private process.
qs.why: Tiga kali berubah pikiran dalam sembilan puluh menit lalu tampil setenang juri: kontras itulah sindirannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kehati-hatian hukum dan opsi bobot putusan membaca perbandingan juri sebagai pujian, padahal teks memakainya untuk menyoroti ketenangan yang dipasang; opsi waktu cukup mengabaikan tiga kali perubahan pikiran yang disebut di kalimat yang sama.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the point about shelves in the third paragraph?
Honouring one title pushes rivals out of a limited stock of notice.
A prize adds attention without taking any from the books it passed over.
Shops widen their tables whenever a season produces several strong titles.
Readers spread their attention fairly evenly across a season's new novels.

qs.evidence: A prize does not merely reward a book; it abolishes several hundred others for the season, since attention is finite and shelves are not elastic.
qs.answer: Honouring one title pushes rivals out of a limited stock of notice.
qs.why: Perhatian terbatas dan rak tidak elastis, jadi satu pemenang menyingkirkan ratusan judul lain dari pandangan selama satu musim.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tanpa dampak membalik kata “abolishes”; opsi rak bisa dilebarkan bertentangan dengan “shelves are not elastic”; opsi perhatian merata bertentangan dengan “attention is finite”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer has served on a judging panel more than once."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer has served on a judging panel more than once.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I have judged a modest regional prize twice, so my scepticism is at least paid for by experience.
qs.why: Dia menyebut menjadi juri dua kali, jadi “lebih dari sekali” itu parafrasa yang pas.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan kata “twice”, dan “Not stated” gagal karena pengalamannya ditulis di paragraf dua.

topic: literary prizes and their effect on readers and publishers
author: Ratih Sudarso
setting: a critical essay on book awards

title: Walls With Better Publicity
text:
Somewhere around 2012 the noun collaboration escaped from its dictionary and began appearing in architectural drawings. Partitions were demolished, desks were shoved into clusters, and the resulting expanse was advertised internally as a space engineered for spontaneous encounter. Nobody mentioned the rental cost per square metre, although the arithmetic was transparent to anybody willing to divide. Language had performed its function: an economy measure had been rebranded as a philosophy of openness.

The empirical case against these interiors is now embarrassingly robust, and it was assembled largely by their occupants. Concentration collapses within earshot of a telephone discussion concerning somebody else's dentist. Acoustic complaints dominate every internal survey I have encountered, and management responds with posters recommending mutual consideration. Employees adapt rationally, acquiring enormous headphones and addressing colleagues exclusively in writing, which produces the pleasant spectacle of an open-plan floor in absolute silence, everybody messaging the neighbour opposite. The architecture achieved the reverse of its declared purpose while remaining a triumph of its undeclared one.

What fascinates me is the vocabulary of the defence, which has proved remarkably durable. Objectors are described as resistant to change, a phrase that converts a technical complaint into a defect of personality. Requests for a door become requests for privilege. Meanwhile the executives who commissioned the openness retain their own enclosed suites at the far end of the building, an arrangement nobody has yet described as an obstacle to spontaneous encounter.

The pandemic years supplied an accidental experiment, and its findings embarrassed almost everybody. Offered a genuine choice, most employees preferred to concentrate at home and to commute precisely for the conversations the open plan had promised to manufacture. Presence recovered its value, though for reasons the original design had never anticipated. They wanted a canteen, a corridor and somebody to disagree with over lunch. Nobody had ever wanted to overhear a stranger negotiating a mortgage.

So the desks are being rearranged once more, and a fresh vocabulary already circulates in the trade press. We now construct neighbourhoods, quiet pods and zones of intentional focus, which are partitions with superior publicity. Consultants have rediscovered the wall and are charging handsomely for the discovery. I oppose none of it, and my own department acquired two modest rooms last winter through this linguistic evolution. I would simply like the record to indicate that the partitions vanished for financial reasons and are reappearing for financial reasons, and that the philosophy has been trailing quietly behind the budget throughout, carrying the bags.
qs: How does the writer connect the cost of floor space to the language of openness?
He argues the philosophy came first and the savings arrived as a welcome bonus.
He treats the talk of openness as cover for a decision about money.
He accepts that openness and cheaper floor space were pursued as one honest aim.
He suspects the savings were too modest to have driven the decision at all.

qs.evidence: Language had performed its function: an economy measure had been rebranded as a philosophy of openness.
qs.answer: He treats the talk of openness as cover for a decision about money.
qs.why: Teks menyimpulkan langkah penghematan telah dikemas ulang sebagai filosofi keterbukaan, jadi bahasanya menutupi motif anggaran.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi filosofi lebih dulu membalik urutan yang dinyatakan teks; opsi satu tujuan jujur menghapus kata “rebranded”; opsi penghematan terlalu kecil bertentangan dengan hitungan sewa per meter persegi yang disebut transparan bagi siapa pun yang mau membagi.

qs: What can be inferred from the position of the executives' own rooms?
The suites were kept because senior staff handle confidential business in them.
Executives use the suites rarely, preferring to sit among their own teams.
Complaints about the suites were made and then quietly set aside.
Those imposing the openness exempted themselves without attracting complaint.

qs.evidence: Meanwhile the executives who commissioned the openness retain their own enclosed suites at the far end of the building, an arrangement nobody has yet described as an obstacle to spontaneous encounter.
qs.answer: Those imposing the openness exempted themselves without attracting complaint.
qs.why: Pihak yang memerintahkan keterbukaan tetap memegang ruang tertutup, dan teks menekankan belum ada yang menyebut itu penghalang perjumpaan spontan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi urusan rahasia menambahkan pembenaran yang tidak ada di teks; opsi jarang dipakai bertentangan dengan kata “retain”; opsi keluhan yang diabaikan bertentangan dengan “nobody has yet described”.

qs: What is the writer's tone in describing the silent open-plan floor?
Sincerely pleased that employees found such a considerate solution.
Measured, reporting an adaptation he considers entirely rational.
Mildly saddened by colleagues who now write instead of speaking.
Dryly comic about a design defeated by the people inside it.

qs.evidence: Employees adapt rationally, acquiring enormous headphones and addressing colleagues exclusively in writing, which produces the pleasant spectacle of an open-plan floor in absolute silence, everybody messaging the neighbour opposite.
qs.answer: Dryly comic about a design defeated by the people inside it.
qs.why: Frasa “the pleasant spectacle” dipakai ironis: lantai terbuka yang sunyi total dijadikan bahan tawa kering.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi senang tulus melewatkan ironinya; opsi laporan terukur memakai kata “rationally” dari teks tetapi menghapus penilaian lucu yang jelas ada; opsi sedih tidak didukung karena perilaku staf disajikan sebagai tontonan menyenangkan, bukan kerugian.

qs: What work does the phrase "resistant to change" perform, according to the writer?
It turns a practical objection into a flaw inside the objector.
It records a finding that the internal acoustic survey had already confirmed.
It describes the staff who asked to keep an enclosed room downstairs.
It credits the employees who settled into the new clusters quickly.

qs.evidence: Objectors are described as resistant to change, a phrase that converts a technical complaint into a defect of personality.
qs.answer: It turns a practical objection into a flaw inside the objector.
qs.why: Teks menyebut frasa itu mengubah keluhan teknis menjadi cacat kepribadian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi temuan survei membaca frasa itu sebagai data, padahal teks menyebutnya label untuk penolak; opsi staf yang minta ruang tertutup salah rujukan, sebab ruang tertutup dipegang para eksekutif; opsi memuji karyawan membalik nada frasanya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Falling rents are the reason the partitions are now being rebuilt."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Falling rents are the reason the partitions are now being rebuilt.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: I would simply like the record to indicate that the partitions vanished for financial reasons and are reappearing for financial reasons, and that the philosophy has been trailing quietly behind the budget throughout, carrying the bags.
qs.why: Teks memang bilang alasannya keuangan, tapi tidak pernah menyebut sewa turun. Sebab spesifik itu tidak dinyatakan.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” menambah sebab yang tidak ada di teks, dan “False” juga salah karena tidak ada kalimat yang membantah soal sewa.

topic: open-plan offices and the language used to justify them
author: Bagas Wirasena
setting: a critical essay on workplace design

title: Translation Is Loss Arranged Intelligently
text:
A director of considerable reputation announced last spring that dubbing constitutes a form of vandalism, and the internet applauded for roughly a week. Subtitles, we were assured, preserve the performance, while dubbing replaces the actor's soul with a stranger's larynx. It is a stirring argument, delivered with total confidence, and it collapses the moment you examine who is permitted to hold it. Purity is inexpensive when you were raised inside the language the film was shot in.

Consider what subtitles actually cost the viewer, since somebody ought to. Reading occupies the eyes, and the eyes are the instrument the director spent eleven months arranging shots for. Every glance downwards is a small confiscation of the image, and the confiscations accumulate across two hours until a considerable portion of the composition has gone unwatched. The subtitled viewer is not experiencing the film unmediated. That viewer is doing two occupations at once, competently, and calling the result fidelity.

Dubbing, meanwhile, has been unfairly represented by its worst practitioners. Yes, the inexpensive dub arrives with mouths flapping out of sequence and a voice actor apparently reading from a menu. But a translated performance can also be a genuine collaboration, recorded with attention to breath and hesitation, and countries with mature dubbing traditions produce work that their audiences experience as ordinary cinema rather than as damage.
