qs.evidence: None of this was planned by anyone, yet it possesses an unmistakable order, and that order was inscribed by use rather than by drawing.
qs.answer: The order arose from repeated use precisely because nothing was drawn first.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang tempat itu nggak dirancang siapa pun tapi punya tatanan jelas yang lahir dari pemakaian. Jadi ketiadaan rancangan justru syarat tatanannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Survei distrik cuma mencatat celah tanpa bayangan antara dua plot bernomor; tatanannya nggak dipasang pejabat. Penulis membacanya dari jejak fisik — puntung, peti, tanaman — bukan dari ingatan. Dan teks bilang tatanan itu lahir justru karena nggak ada yang menggambar apa pun lebih dulu.

qs: What does the passage imply about the notice announcing the scheme?
It suggests that residents had asked the depot for a tidier approach.
It shows that the fence had become unsafe for people passing the depot.
It means the strip will finally be recorded on the district survey.
It confirms that the strip will lose the quality the writer values.

qs.evidence: A notice announced a forthcoming scheme of tidying, comprising three trees and a paved path.
qs.answer: It confirms that the strip will lose the quality the writer values.
qs.why: Penulis udah bilang nilai tempat itu justru ketiadaan fungsi, jadi rencana penataan berarti nilai itu bakal hilang. Itu simpulan yang paling didukung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Nggak ada permintaan warga di teks; yang muncul cuma pemberitahuan rencana. Pagarnya disebut diperbarui, bukan berbahaya. Dan strip itu sejak paragraf pertama sudah tercatat di survei distrik, jadi bukan pencatatan yang baru datang.

qs: Which phrase best characterizes the writer's attitude in the final paragraph?
Measured approval of a tidying that the ground has long needed.
Cool detachment, recording the scheme without minding either way.
Settled bitterness towards planners who fill in every unused gap.
Reluctant regret, admitting that the improvement has real merits.

qs.evidence: I discovered that I minded considerably more than I could justify to anybody who enquired.
qs.answer: Reluctant regret, admitting that the improvement has real merits.
qs.why: Penulis ngaku kesal tapi susah membenarkan kekesalannya, lalu ngakuin pohon dan jalur beton itu ada gunanya. Itu penyesalan yang setengah malu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penulis ngaku “minded considerably more than I could justify”, jadi bukan sikap dingin yang nggak peduli dan bukan persetujuan yang tenang. Dia juga nggak menyalahkan perencana: tiga pohon disebut lebih baik daripada nol, dan jalur beton lebih baik daripada lumpur Februari.

qs: Which sentence most closely restates the writer's explanation of the term used by architects?
The label marks plots that were numbered but never actually built on.
The label marks ground that no drawing managed to account for.
The label marks ground a scheme has deliberately left for loitering.
The label marks sites too contaminated by fuel or waste to be used.

qs.evidence: The label is accurate and faintly clinical: residual space is whatever the drawings could not absorb, and every scheme generates some, however meticulous the planner has been.
qs.answer: The label marks ground that no drawing managed to account for.
qs.why: Teks jelasin istilah itu sebagai ruang yang nggak bisa diserap gambar rancangan. Kunci ini nyatain hal yang sama dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang residual adalah apa pun yang nggak bisa diserap gambar rancangan, dan tiap skema menghasilkan sebagiannya. Plot bernomor itu hal lain yang muncul di survei. Ruang buat berhenti tanpa membeli apa-apa adalah nilai yang penulis temukan, bukan definisi istilahnya. Dan bau diesel bukan pencemaran yang masuk definisi.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer had been stopping at the strip regularly for the whole of the eleven years."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer had been stopping at the strip regularly for the whole of the eleven years.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I have trudged past it for eleven years, and recently I began pausing there, largely because I had exhausted my pretexts for hurrying.
qs.why: Teks nyebut dua keterangan waktu yang beda: sebelas tahun itu lama dia berjalan lewat, sementara kebiasaan berhenti baru dimulai belakangan (“recently I began pausing there”). Jadi klaim bahwa dia rutin berhenti sepanjang sebelas tahun itu dikontradiksi teks, bukan cuma nggak disebut — kuncinya False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” cuma jalan kalau kamu menyamakan dua keterangan waktu yang sengaja dipisah penulis: berjalan lewat selama sebelas tahun vs mulai berhenti baru-baru ini. “Not stated” juga gagal karena teks nggak diam soal ini: kata “recently I began” eksplisit menempatkan kebiasaan berhenti di akhir rentang sebelas tahun, jadi durasinya terbantah, bukan dibiarkan kosong.

topic: leftover urban ground and its uses
author: Dania Prakoso
setting: a narrow strip of land behind a bus depot

title: The Look of Letting Go
text:
Rewilding arrived in public debate with an unusually attractive promise: step back, spend less, and permit a landscape to repair itself. The promise is not hollow, and several estates now support more insects, birds, and standing water than they did throughout a century of drainage. Yet the word conveys a second cargo, quieter and harder to defend, concerning what a repaired landscape ought to resemble. That second cargo is aesthetic rather than ecological, and it accounts for much of the controversy that follows any announcement.

Consider the thorn scrub that appears within four years of a fence coming down. Ecologically it is admirable, since it shelters seedlings, sustains finches, and retains the soil throughout winter rain. Visually it reads as neglect. Tidiness has functioned as a moral quality in the countryside for generations, and a straight-cut hedge has signified a household in respectable standing. The objection lodged at the parish meeting is rarely about biodiversity at all, whatever vocabulary is employed, and it will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts.

Advocates entertain their own version of the same confusion, and it deserves equal scrutiny. Photographs in the brochures display broad grassland, a distant herd, and a horizon uninterrupted by fences or sheds. This is not what most restored ground resembles in year six, when the scrub is impenetrable and the paths are muddy and closed. Marketing an image of open emptiness will produce visitors who feel cheated by the thicket that ecology genuinely requires. A promise made in pictures will be judged in pictures.

A further difficulty exists, which the more candid projects now concede in their annual reports. Permitting a landscape to decide for itself sounds like an absence of decisions, yet somebody determined which fences fell, which grazing animals arrived, and which year counted as the point of departure. Nothing in Britain has remained beyond human management long enough for a genuinely hands-off baseline to exist. The choice is between visible management and management that has been made to look like nature.

None of this constitutes a case against the practice, which on the evidence assembled so far does more good than harm. It is a case against the vocabulary of stepping back, which promises humility and delivers an unexamined preference. Declare instead that a particular stretch of ground is being managed for insects rather than for appearance, and that it will appear untidy for a decade. That sentence forfeits the romance. It also survives contact with the parish meeting, which the romance never does.
qs: What is the relationship between the two objections the essay examines?
Both arise from expectations about appearance rather than from ecology itself.
The first is ecological, while the second concerns the income of estates.
The second was raised by advocates in order to answer the first one.
Both would be settled by another leaflet setting out the species counts in detail.

qs.evidence: The objection lodged at the parish meeting is rarely about biodiversity at all, whatever vocabulary is employed, and it will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts.
qs.answer: Both arise from expectations about appearance rather than from ecology itself.
qs.why: Penolak dan pendukung sama-sama terjebak soal tampilan: yang satu nganggep scrub itu terbengkalai, yang lain jualan foto padang terbuka. Sumbernya selera visual, bukan ekologi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang keberatan di rapat paroki jarang benar-benar soal keanekaragaman, jadi yang pertama bukan keberatan ekologis. Pendapatan estate nggak dibahas. Kekeliruan kedua muncul di brosur pendukung, bukan sebagai jawaban atas yang pertama. Dan selebaran penuh hitungan spesies justru disebut nggak akan menjawabnya.

qs: What does the essay imply about a visitor arriving in the sixth year?
Such a visitor will find the paths open and the grassland as photographed.
Such a visitor will be handed the annual report with its species counts.
Such a visitor is likely to be disappointed by ground that the brochures hid.
Such a visitor will usually leave before reaching the thorn scrub at all.

qs.evidence: Marketing an image of open emptiness will produce visitors who feel cheated by the thicket that ecology genuinely requires.
qs.answer: Such a visitor is likely to be disappointed by ground that the brochures hid.
qs.why: Teks bilang jualan citra kosong-terbuka bikin pengunjung merasa dikibulin sama belukar yang sebenarnya dibutuhkan. Tahun keenam justru saat belukarnya rapat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang di tahun keenam belukarnya rapat dan jalurnya berlumpur serta ditutup, jadi bukan padang terbuka seperti di foto. Laporan tahunan disebut sebagai tempat proyek mengakui kesulitan, bukan bahan sambutan pengunjung. Dan kepergian pengunjung sebelum sampai belukar nggak pernah disebut.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the phrase about stepping back?
Approving, since the phrase names the humility the practice really needs.
Critical, treating it as language that disguises a decision as restraint.
Amused, treating the phrase as harmless marketing nobody takes literally.
Dismissive of the whole practice, whatever vocabulary is chosen for it.

qs.evidence: It is a case against the vocabulary of stepping back, which promises humility and delivers an unexamined preference.
qs.answer: Critical, treating it as language that disguises a decision as restraint.
qs.why: Penulis nyerang ungkapannya, bukan praktiknya: frasa itu menjanjikan kerendahan hati tapi nyelundupin selera yang nggak pernah diperiksa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Frasanya disebut menjanjikan kerendahan hati tapi menyerahkan selera yang nggak pernah diperiksa — jadi bukan pujian. Penulis juga nggak menganggapnya iklan tak berbahaya: justru dari situ kontroversi rapat paroki muncul. Dan praktiknya sendiri dia sebut lebih banyak gunanya daripada ruginya.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does "reads" describe?
The act of studying a written notice fixed to a farm gate.
A figure taken from an instrument left out in the scrub.
The measurement of soil moisture through the winter rain.
How the scrub is interpreted by people who look at it.

qs.evidence: Visually it reads as neglect.
qs.answer: How the scrub is interpreted by people who look at it.
qs.why: Kata “Visually” di depannya nunjukin ini soal bagaimana orang menafsirkan pemandangan, bukan aktivitas membaca atau angka alat ukur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kata “Visually” di depannya nunjukin ini soal bagaimana pemandangan itu ditafsirkan orang. Jadi bukan membaca papan di gerbang, bukan angka dari alat ukur, dan bukan pengukuran kelembapan tanah — hujan musim dingin di teks cuma soal tanah yang tertahan belukar.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Thorn scrub takes roughly twenty years to appear once a fence is removed."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Thorn scrub takes roughly twenty years to appear once a fence is removed.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Consider the thorn scrub that appears within four years of a fence coming down.
qs.why: Teks nyebut belukar berduri muncul dalam empat tahun setelah pagar dilepas. Klaim dua puluh tahun nukar angkanya, jadi kontradiksi langsung alias False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak angka empat tahun di teks. “Not stated” salah karena tenggat waktunya justru disebut jelas.

topic: rewilding and the aesthetics of untidiness
author: Ellis Nurhadi
setting: estates and parish meetings in the British countryside

title: The Arithmetic of Disagreement
text:
A study that fails to reproduce an earlier result is customarily described as a failed replication, and the phrase quietly assigns blame. Something has gone wrong, the reader assumes, either in the original laboratory or in the one that followed it. Yet the arithmetic of sampling guarantees that some proportion of well-conducted studies will disagree, even where the underlying effect is perfectly stable. Disagreement is therefore not a symptom of incompetence but a predictable feature of measurement under variation. The vocabulary of failure nevertheless has consequences for reputations, for funding, and for the willingness of laboratories to publish inconvenient outcomes.

Pre-registration was introduced to address a narrower problem, namely the flexibility that a researcher retains after the data have arrived. Analytical choices are numerous: which participants to exclude, which measure to privilege, which comparison to report as the principal one. Each decision is defensible in isolation, and their combination can manufacture a convincing result from noise alone. By recording the intended analysis in advance, the investigator surrenders that flexibility and converts an ambiguous exercise into a genuine test. Nothing in the procedure prevents a foolish hypothesis from being tested, and nothing guarantees that the test will prove interesting.

The reform has been widely adopted, and its consequences are instructive rather than triumphant. Registered studies report smaller effects and null findings far more frequently than their unregistered predecessors. Critics interpret this as evidence that the literature was previously inflated, which is plausible but not the only available reading. Registration also discourages the exploratory work from which unexpected hypotheses have historically emerged. A discipline that registers everything may become reliable and simultaneously rather dull, and whether that trade is acceptable depends upon what a particular field most urgently lacks.

Two objectives are being conflated here, and separating them clarifies the disagreement considerably. Exploration generates candidate explanations; confirmation determines whether a candidate survives an honest attempt to refute it. Both are indispensable, and neither can substitute for the other without damage to the enterprise. Confirmation without prior exploration examines hypotheses that nobody had reason to entertain, while exploration without subsequent confirmation accumulates suggestions that nobody has tested. The methodological error lies not in exploring but in presenting exploration as though it had been confirmation.

For the reader outside the field, one practical inference follows from all of this. A single striking finding, however elegantly presented, warrants provisional interest rather than belief. The question worth asking is not whether a result is significant but whether anybody has yet attempted to reproduce it, and with what outcome. Until that question has an answer, the finding remains a hypothesis wearing formal clothing, and provisional interest is an underrated posture that costs remarkably little to maintain.
qs: Which statement best expresses the article's central claim?
The real fault is disguising exploratory work as a completed test.
The real fault lies in the phrase failed replication and the blame it assigns.
Sampling variation accounts for most disagreement between published studies.
Pre-registration costs a discipline more in dullness than it ever returns.

qs.evidence: The methodological error lies not in exploring but in presenting exploration as though it had been confirmation.
qs.answer: The real fault is disguising exploratory work as a completed test.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang kesalahan metodologisnya bukan menjelajah, tapi menyajikan penjelajahan seolah-olah itu pengujian. Kunci ini nyatain hal yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kosakata “failed replication” memang dibahas di paragraf pertama, tapi kesalahan metodologisnya ditaruh teks pada menyajikan penjelajahan sebagai konfirmasi. Variasi sampling cuma menjamin sebagian studi berbeda, bukan menjelaskan sebagian besar ketidaksesuaian. Dan soal jadi membosankan penulis cuma bilang “mungkin”, dengan untung-ruginya tergantung kebutuhan bidangnya.

qs: What does the article imply about a researcher who makes several defensible choices?
Such a researcher will usually be caught by reviewers before publication.
Such a researcher has probably excluded participants for improper reasons.
Such a researcher may reach a persuasive conclusion without any deliberate dishonesty.
Such a researcher must have registered the intended analysis before any data had arrived.

qs.evidence: Each decision is defensible in isolation, and their combination can manufacture a convincing result from noise alone.
qs.answer: Such a researcher may reach a persuasive conclusion without any deliberate dishonesty.
qs.why: Setiap pilihan disebut bisa dibela sendiri-sendiri, tapi gabungannya bisa memproduksi hasil yang meyakinkan dari derau. Artinya hasil palsu bisa muncul tanpa niat curang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang tiap pilihan bisa dibela sendiri-sendiri, jadi nggak ada alasan tak pantas yang perlu diasumsikan. Peninjau nggak pernah disebut menangkap apa pun. Dan registrasi justru digambarkan sebagai kebalikan situasi ini: keleluasaan itu dilepas di depan.

qs: Which phrase best describes the author's assessment of the reform?
Qualified approval, noting a cost alongside the acknowledged gain.
Warm endorsement of a change whose costs have been overstated by critics.
Guarded scepticism, doubting that registration changed much in practice.
Mild impatience with critics who read the null findings as vindication.

qs.evidence: The reform has been widely adopted, and its consequences are instructive rather than triumphant.
qs.answer: Qualified approval, noting a cost alongside the acknowledged gain.
qs.why: Kata “instructive rather than triumphant” nunjukin penulis setuju tapi nahan diri: ada untung, ada harga yang dibayar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Akibat reformasi disebut “instructive rather than triumphant” dan dua sisinya ditaruh berdampingan, jadi bukan dukungan hangat yang menyebut kritiknya berlebihan. Dampaknya jelas dinilai nyata — efek lebih kecil dan temuan nol lebih sering — jadi bukan skeptis soal apakah ada yang berubah. Dan pembacaan kritikus cuma disebut masuk akal tapi bukan satu-satunya, bukan sasaran kekesalan.

qs: Which statement best restates the advice given to non-specialist readers?
Ask whether the analysis was registered before the data had been collected.
Ask whether the finding has been independently repeated, not whether it is impressive.
Prefer findings from the largest laboratories, since their samples are usually much bigger.
Ask which participants were excluded before the main comparison was picked.

qs.evidence: The question worth asking is not whether a result is significant but whether anybody has yet attempted to reproduce it, and with what outcome.
qs.answer: Ask whether the finding has been independently repeated, not whether it is impressive.
qs.why: Nasihatnya: jangan tanya apakah hasilnya signifikan, tapi apakah sudah ada yang mencoba mengulangnya. Kunci ini pas persis, cuma beda kata.
qs.whyOthersFail: Nasihatnya bukan soal registrasi: teks bilang pertanyaan yang layak adalah apakah sudah ada yang mencoba mengulang hasilnya, dan dengan hasil apa. Ukuran laboratorium nggak pernah disebut sebagai pegangan. Dan peserta yang dikeluarkan itu contoh keleluasaan analisis, bukan saran untuk pembaca luar bidang.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Studies with a pre-declared analysis more often produce modest or empty results."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Studies with a pre-declared analysis more often produce modest or empty results.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Registered studies report smaller effects and null findings far more frequently than their unregistered predecessors.
qs.why: Teks bilang studi teregistrasi lebih sering melaporkan efek yang lebih kecil dan temuan nol. Klaimnya ganti kata jadi “modest or empty”, isinya identik, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh pernyataan berlawanan yang nggak ada di teks. “Not stated” gagal karena perbandingan itu justru disebut eksplisit.

topic: replication and pre-registration in empirical research
author: Farah Kusnadi
setting: the methodological literature of the empirical sciences

title: Four Bars, Eleven Weeks
text:
The passage occupies four bars and has defeated me for eleven weeks, which is longer than I care to concede. It is not rapid, and nothing within it exceeds the reach of an ordinary hand or the patience of an ordinary pupil. The difficulty is a shift, a migration of the left hand from one position to another, executed while the bow continues without interruption. Performed correctly it is inaudible; performed incorrectly it announces itself to the entire structure like a dropped tray. My teacher calls the join a seam, which is a generous term for what is currently a hole.

Practice, properly understood, is not repetition, although repetition is what an observer would notice; repetition merely reinforces whatever the hand is already performing, including the error. What the labour actually requires is diagnosis, and diagnosis is sluggish, unglamorous, and occasionally humiliating in a manner no audience ever witnesses. I have discovered that my thumb releases a fraction of a beat too late, that my elbow anticipates the movement, and that I hold my breath throughout. None of these observations arrived through effort; each arrived through attention, which is a different faculty altogether. Attention, unlike effort, cannot be increased by wanting it more, which is the discovery nobody advertises.

There is a peculiar consolation in difficulties of this kind, and it bears no relation to music whatever. The seam is unmoved by my intentions, my fatigue, or the general quality of my week. It responds to precisely one variable, which is whether the thumb releases at the appropriate instant, and to no other consideration whatsoever. Such indifference is restful after a day spent among colleagues whose responses depend on everything except accuracy. Nothing else in my day offers a verdict that cannot be negotiated, postponed or flattered.

Progress, when it eventually arrives, is unrecognizable as such from the inside, and frequently invisible from without. On Tuesday the shift succeeded twice, and I assumed the successes were accidental, because they felt like nothing at all. That is apparently the sensation of a movement becoming automatic: the effort disappears an instant before the achievement registers. Mastery, in other words, is experienced as an absence rather than as an accomplishment, which explains why nobody boasts convincingly about it.

I shall not pretend the four bars have been conquered, because on Thursday the seam reopened without warning; something has nevertheless altered in how I regard the eleven weeks. The passage was never the objective; it was the instrument through which a particular kind of attention was constructed. The bars will be succeeded by other bars, each concealing its own hole, and the attention will be waiting for them. That, I suspect, is what practising has invariably been for, whatever the concert programme claims.
qs: What is the writer's main point about the eleven weeks of work?
Eleven weeks of daily repetition finally made the difficult shift reliable.
The value of the struggle lay in building a capacity for close notice.
Difficult passages are best defeated by lengthening the practice session.
A teacher's vocabulary decides how a pupil experiences a technical fault.

qs.evidence: The passage was never the objective; it was the instrument through which a particular kind of attention was constructed.
qs.answer: The value of the struggle lay in building a capacity for close notice.
qs.why: Penulis bilang bagian itu bukan tujuan, tapi alat buat membangun semacam perhatian. Jadi hasil sebenarnya adalah kemampuan mengamati.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang hari Kamis seam-nya kebuka lagi tanpa peringatan, jadi shift-nya belum andal. Pengulangan justru disebut cuma memperkuat apa pun yang sudah dilakukan tangan, termasuk kesalahannya, jadi bukan soal sesi yang diperpanjang. Dan istilah “seam” dari guru cuma dikomentari sekilas, bukan penentu pengalaman muridnya.

qs: What can be inferred about the relation between trying hard and improving?
Trying harder pays off once the daily hours are long enough.
Improvement depends mainly on the length of each practice session.
Trying harder is not the same as noticing accurately.
Noticing an error stops the hand from repeating it again.

qs.evidence: None of these observations arrived through effort; each arrived through attention, which is a different faculty altogether.
qs.answer: Trying harder is not the same as noticing accurately.
qs.why: Teks bedain usaha dari perhatian dan bilang keduanya kemampuan berbeda. Jadi kerja keras nggak otomatis sama dengan mengamati dengan tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bedain usaha dari perhatian dan bilang perhatian nggak bisa ditambah dengan lebih menginginkannya, jadi jam yang lebih panjang bukan jawabannya. Panjang sesi nggak pernah disebut. Dan penulis tetap gagal lagi hari Kamis walau sudah tahu letak kesalahannya.

qs: What attitude does the writer express towards the seam's indifference?
Quiet pride in an instrument that rewards nothing but honest effort.
Resignation, since the seam gives its verdict however carefully the work is done.
Relief, because its verdict cannot be flattered or negotiated.
Mild resentment at a standard that ignores how the week has gone.

qs.evidence: Such indifference is restful after a day spent among colleagues whose responses depend on everything except accuracy.
qs.answer: Relief, because its verdict cannot be flattered or negotiated.
qs.why: Kata “restful” nunjukin rasa lega: cuma ketepatan yang dihitung, dan itu melegakan setelah sehari penuh respons yang bisa dinegosiasi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kata “restful” dan kontras dengan rekan kerja yang responsnya bisa dinegosiasi nunjukin rasa lega, bukan pasrah dan bukan dongkol. Dan usaha justru yang disebut nggak dihargai seam: yang dihitung cuma apakah jempolnya lepas pada saat yang tepat, jadi bukan kebanggaan atas kerja keras.

qs: What does "seam" refer to in the first paragraph?
A line of stitching sewn along the edge of a garment by hand.
A fault line in the wooden body of the instrument itself.
The moment when the bow changes direction without a sound.
The join between two hand positions that should be undetectable.

qs.evidence: My teacher calls the join a seam, which is a generous term for what is currently a hole.
qs.answer: The join between two hand positions that should be undetectable.
qs.why: Kata itu dipakai buat sambungan perpindahan tangan yang, kalau benar, nggak kedengaran. Guru pakai istilah itu buat titik rawan tadi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Guru memakai istilah itu buat sambungan perpindahan tangan kiri yang, kalau benar, nggak kedengaran. Bow justru disebut berjalan terus tanpa henti selama perpindahan itu. Jahitan pakaian dan retakan kayu instrumen makna lain kata yang sama, dan nggak nyangkut ke posisi tangan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer regarded Tuesday's two successful shifts as proof of secure progress."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer regarded Tuesday's two successful shifts as proof of secure progress.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: On Tuesday the shift succeeded twice, and I assumed the successes were accidental, because they felt like nothing at all.
qs.why: Teks bilang penulis nganggep dua keberhasilan itu kebetulan, bukan bukti kemajuan. Klaimnya membalik sikap itu, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak kata “accidental” di kalimat yang sama. “Not stated” salah karena sikap penulis soal hari Selasa disebut jelas.

author: Gita Halimah
setting: a domestic practice room with a cello

title: What the Glass Actually Does
text:
No building material has been required to shoulder more ideology than glass, and none has borne it so uncomplainingly. Since the nineteen-twenties, architects have presented the transparent facade as a moral proposition: nothing concealed, nothing forbidden, the interior offered candidly to the street. The vocabulary survives in the marketing of every recent headquarters, where openness is promised as though it were a structural property of the cladding. Enquiry into what the glass actually does, as distinct from what the brochure claims it signifies, is overdue.

Consider the tower from the pavement at four o'clock on a bright afternoon in June, when the facade is not transparent at all but a mirror, returning the sky, the traffic, and the pedestrian's own reflection at maximum brightness. Transparency, in the literal sense, requires a contrast in illumination, and by daylight the exterior is invariably brighter than the interior behind it. The building becomes visually accessible only after dark, when virtually nobody is watching and its occupants have departed. The heavily advertised openness is therefore scheduled for the hours in which it cannot be exercised.

Inside, the arrangement inverts, since the occupants may be observed continuously by anybody with an appetite for observing them. Glazed partitions abolish the enclosed office, and with it the possibility of a discussion nobody overhears. This is presented as a flattening of hierarchy, and in one narrow respect it genuinely is. But the senior staff have retreated upward to a storey with fewer visitors, while the transparency operates most severely upon those with the least authority. Visibility, distributed unevenly, is merely supervision under a more agreeable name.

A thermal contradiction also exists, recorded in the performance figures investors rarely quote and brochures never mention. A glazed envelope admits heat in summer and surrenders it in winter, forcing the mechanical plant to work continuously against the weather. Occupants, meanwhile, complain of glare and draughts in the same quarterly comfort survey, year after year. The building appearing weightless consumes more energy than the heavy masonry it replaced, and lightness, it turns out, is an appearance supported by machinery in the basement.

None of this amounts to an argument against glass, which remains structurally essential and frequently exquisite in the right hands. The argument concerns the metaphor, and metaphors are not innocent when recruited to characterize institutions. A company does not become candid by installing a glazed wall, any more than a person becomes honest by removing a curtain. Candour is a practice, patiently maintained and occasionally extravagant, and leaves no trace in an elevation drawing. The tower, meanwhile, reflects the street back at itself, perhaps the most accurate act it has ever performed.
qs: What is the relationship between glazed partitions and workplace hierarchy?
The partitions have largely flattened hierarchy, much as advocates predicted.
Senior staff are watched most closely of all, since their floor has the most glass.
Hierarchy chiefly decides which parts of a facade may reflect the sky.
The partitions expose junior staff while leaving seniority largely untouched.

qs.evidence: Visibility, distributed unevenly, is merely supervision under a more agreeable name.
qs.answer: The partitions expose junior staff while leaving seniority largely untouched.
qs.why: Teks bilang keterlihatan dibagi nggak rata dan paling keras menimpa yang paling sedikit wewenangnya, sementara atasan pindah ke lantai yang jarang didatangi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang pemerataan hierarki itu benar cuma dalam satu segi sempit, dan keterlihatan yang dibagi nggak rata cuma pengawasan dengan nama lebih enak. Staf senior justru pindah ke lantai yang jarang didatangi. Dan pantulan langit soal kontras cahaya siang, bukan soal hierarki.

qs: What does the essay imply about the promised openness of the facade?
It is available whenever the interior is brighter than the pavement outside.
It was never actually promised by the architects who designed the tower.
It is available precisely when there is nobody left to benefit from it.
It disappears as soon as the mechanical plant starts working against the weather.

qs.evidence: The building becomes visually accessible only after dark, when virtually nobody is watching and its occupants have departed.
qs.answer: It is available precisely when there is nobody left to benefit from it.
qs.why: Gedungnya baru bisa dilihat ke dalam setelah gelap, saat hampir nggak ada yang menonton dan penghuninya pulang. Jadi keterbukaannya datang saat nggak ada gunanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Interior baru lebih terang setelah gelap, dan justru saat itu penghuninya sudah pulang, jadi bukan “kapan pun”. Arsitek sejak tahun dua puluhan disebut memang menjanjikan keterbukaan itu. Dan mesin di basement dikaitkan ke energi dan kenyamanan, bukan ke hilangnya keterlihatan.

qs: The remark about openness being scheduled is best described as which of these?
An admiring note on a facade that rewards visitors after dark.
A sardonic observation exposing a gap between claim and effect.
A neutral summary of the hours in which the tower is lit.
A technical correction about how the interior is illuminated.

qs.evidence: The heavily advertised openness is therefore scheduled for the hours in which it cannot be exercised.
qs.answer: A sardonic observation exposing a gap between claim and effect.
qs.why: Kata “much-advertised” plus “tidak bisa dijalankan” bikin kalimat itu menohok: janjinya dan kenyataannya nggak ketemu. Itu ironi getir, bukan laporan datar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Frasa “heavily advertised” dipasang persis di sebelah “cannot be exercised”, jadi kalimatnya menohok janji itu, bukan memuji pengunjung malam. Teks juga nggak melaporkan jam penyalaan lampu, dan nggak ada koreksi teknis soal pencahayaan interior.

qs: Which sentence most closely restates the writer's point about candour?
An organization becomes trustworthy once its internal walls are glazed.
A person who draws a curtain is concealing something worth hiding.
An organization cannot acquire openness merely by altering its architecture.
A company that publishes its energy figures will be believed by the visitors it receives.

qs.evidence: A company does not become candid by installing a glazed wall, any more than a person becomes honest by removing a curtain.
qs.answer: An organization cannot acquire openness merely by altering its architecture.
qs.why: Analogi tirai di teks bilang keterusterangan nggak didapat dengan memasang dinding kaca. Kunci ini merumuskan ulang dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Analogi tirai dipakai buat menolak dua arah sekaligus: dinding kaca nggak bikin perusahaan terus terang, dan tirai yang ditutup bukan tanda ada yang disembunyikan. Angka energi disebut sebagai hal yang investor jarang kutip, bukan sumber kepercayaan pengunjung.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "A fully glazed skin loses warmth during the colder months."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: A fully glazed skin loses warmth during the colder months.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A glazed envelope admits heat in summer and surrenders it in winter, forcing the mechanical plant to work continuously against the weather.
qs.why: Teks bilang selubung berkaca menyerahkan panas pada musim dingin. Klaimnya cuma ganti “surrenders it in winter” jadi kehilangan panas di bulan-bulan dingin, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” perlu pernyataan bahwa kaca menahan panas di musim dingin, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena perilaku termalnya disebut langsung.

topic: glass facades and claims of institutional openness
author: Haris Danuwijaya
setting: a newly completed corporate tower

title: The Argument in the Margin
text:
A secondhand bookshop offers two physically indistinguishable categories: volumes read and volumes merely owned. The contrast declares itself in the margins, where a previous reader has argued, agreed, complained, or occasionally lost patience altogether. Such annotation is currently unfashionable, and librarians discourage it for entirely defensible reasons, yet the practice reveals more about attention than any survey of borrowing figures. It is nevertheless the most honest record we possess of what reading was once like.

Marginal writing was not invariably eccentric behaviour, and for several centuries it was the expected response to a text of any consequence. Renaissance readers were trained to extract sentences, compare them with sentences from elsewhere, and compose a personal digest for later reference. The margin functioned as a workshop rather than as a comment column, and a blank margin, under that regime, indicated inattention instead of respect. Ownership without engagement was regarded as a species of waste, and waste of an especially bourgeois sort.

Something altered with the mass-produced paperback, and the alteration was economic rather than intellectual in origin. A cheap book is disposable, and a disposable object does not invite the commitment that writing in it implies. Publishers, for their part, never encouraged clients to deface the merchandise, and the library, an institution devoted to shared property, necessarily prohibited the practice altogether. Annotation retreated into the private notebook, invisible to everybody except its author; the habit survived, though its evidence did not.

The digital margin was expected to restore what the paperback removed, and in certain respects it has. Highlighting is now recorded, aggregated, and returned to publishers as a portrait of collective attention, or of collective haste. But an aggregated margin remains a peculiar artefact, reporting where readers paused without reporting why. The most frequently marked sentence in a novel may be its wisest observation or merely its most quotable one, and volume has thereby replaced argument.

I own a copy of a nineteenth-century essay collection in which an earlier reader has written one word forty times. The word is nonsense, appearing beside every passage in which the author praises his own moderation, forty times over. I know nothing further about this reader, not even a name, yet I know precisely where his patience failed him. No aggregated highlight will ever convey that, because the aggregate has no temper and cannot be exasperated by anybody. Reading, at its best, is an argument conducted with somebody absent, and arguments require somewhere to be inscribed.
qs: What is the main point of this commentary?
Renaissance readers made better digests than owners of paperbacks do now.
Notes in margins preserve evidence of engagement that other records lose.
Aggregated highlighting has restored most of what the paperback removed.
Libraries should relax the rules that keep readers out of the margins.

qs.evidence: It is nevertheless the most honest record we possess of what reading was once like.
qs.answer: Notes in margins preserve evidence of engagement that other records lose.
qs.why: Penulis nyebut catatan pinggir sebagai rekaman paling jujur soal bagaimana orang dulu membaca. Kunci ini merumuskan ulang gagasan itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks nggak membandingkan mutu digest antar zaman; yang dibandingkan apa yang terekam. Margin digital disebut memulihkan sebagian saja dan tetap nggak melaporkan alasan pembaca berhenti. Dan larangan pustakawan disebut punya alasan yang sah, bukan hal yang minta dilonggarkan.

qs: What does the commentary imply about the effect of cheap paperbacks?
Cheap volumes were annotated more heavily than the expensive editions before them.
Publishers widened the margins of paperbacks to invite private comment.
Low price reduced the sense that a volume deserved lasting investment.
Low price persuaded libraries to allow writing in their shared copies.

qs.evidence: A cheap book is disposable, and a disposable object does not invite the commitment that writing in it implies.
qs.answer: Low price reduced the sense that a volume deserved lasting investment.
qs.why: Buku murah disebut sekali pakai, dan barang sekali pakai nggak memancing komitmen. Jadi harga murah menurunkan rasa bahwa buku itu layak diperlakukan serius.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang buku murah itu sekali pakai dan barang sekali pakai nggak memancing komitmen, jadi anotasinya surut, bukan bertambah. Penerbit disebut nggak pernah menganjurkan pembeli mencoret dagangannya. Dan perpustakaan justru melarang praktik itu sepenuhnya.

qs: How does the writer regard the aggregated record of highlighting?
Warily hopeful, since the aggregate at least records where readers pause.
Indifferently, since the change concerns publishers rather than readers.
Sharply annoyed at readers who mark only the most quotable sentences.
Sceptically, treating quantity as a poor substitute for reasoning.

qs.evidence: The most frequently marked sentence in a novel may be its wisest observation or merely its most quotable one, and volume has thereby replaced argument.
qs.answer: Sceptically, treating quantity as a poor substitute for reasoning.
qs.why: Penulis nunjukin kalimat yang paling banyak ditandai belum tentu yang paling berbobot, lalu bilang jumlah menggantikan argumen. Itu sikap skeptis.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penulis mengakui agregat mencatat tempat pembaca berhenti, tapi langsung bilang jumlah sudah menggantikan argumen, jadi bukan sikap penuh harap. Dampaknya dia taruh pada pembaca, bukan cuma penerbit. Dan yang dia persoalkan bentuk datanya, bukan selera pembaca perorangan.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does "workshop" suggest about the margin?
A room in which books were bound and afterwards repaired by hand.
A place where material was actively worked upon, not merely judged.
A short course of training attended by readers of the period.
A column set aside for comments on the text beside it.

qs.evidence: The margin functioned as a workshop rather than as a comment column, and a blank margin, under that regime, indicated inattention instead of respect.
qs.answer: A place where material was actively worked upon, not merely judged.
qs.why: Kata itu dikontraskan sama “comment column”, dan konteksnya soal mengekstrak lalu menyusun ulang bahan. Jadi maknanya tempat mengerjakan, bukan tempat menilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks mengontraskan margin sebagai bengkel dengan “comment column”, jadi kolom komentar justru yang ditolak. Penjilidan dan perbaikan buku bengkel dalam arti lain yang nggak dibahas. Dan pelatihan pembaca Renaisans memang disebut, tapi sebagai kebiasaan yang diajarkan, bukan arti kata itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The earlier reader wrote the same word in several other books as well."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The earlier reader wrote the same word in several other books as well.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: I own a copy of a nineteenth-century essay collection in which an earlier reader has written one word forty times.
qs.why: Teks cuma cerita satu jilid dan satu kata yang muncul empat puluh kali di dalamnya. Apa pembaca itu nulis kata yang sama di buku lain nggak pernah disentuh, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nambahin buku yang nggak pernah ada di teks. “False” juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal apa pun soal koleksi pembaca itu; dia cuma diam.

topic: annotation and the history of reading
author: Ilham Sudibyo
setting: a secondhand bookshop and a private shelf

title: What a Photograph Counts
text:
The camera trap has transformed the study of secretive mammals, and it has also transformed what conservation science means by a number. A device fixed to a tree records whatever passes an infrared beam, at any hour, for months without supervision. The resulting archive is enormous, inexpensive by the standards of fieldwork, and almost entirely free of the observer's presence, and it is also, in an important sense, not a census. The distinction is routinely lost between the laboratory and the press release.

An image records a detection, not an animal, and the difference is not merely pedantic. Ten photographs may represent ten individuals, one individual returning ten times, or any arrangement between those extremes. Species bearing distinctive coats, such as the tiger, permit individuals to be identified and counted with reasonable confidence. For a uniformly coloured animal, no such identification is feasible, and abundance must be inferred from a model rather than observed. The model requires assumptions about movement, and those assumptions are precisely what the photographs cannot supply.

Placement introduces a second difficulty, which is less often acknowledged in published summaries. Cameras are positioned on trails, because trails deliver detections and empty forest does not, so animals that avoid trails are underrepresented while those that patrol them are overrepresented. The archive documents the intersection of two behaviours: the animal's use of paths and the researcher's expectation about paths. Corrections exist, they are ingenious, and they depend upon further assumptions of their own.

None of this undermines the method, which has produced findings unobtainable by any other means. Populations previously characterized as extinct have been photographed; nocturnal behaviour long assumed has ultimately been documented. The proper conclusion is narrower and more useful than either enthusiasm or dismissal. A detection rate is a robust measure of change at one location over time, and a fragile measure of quantity at any single moment. Comparisons across years, at identical stations, are therefore far safer than comparisons across landscapes.

The practical hazard lies downstream, in the sentence that reaches a ministry or a newspaper. Somewhere between the model and the summary, an estimate loses its interval and acquires an air of authority it never possessed. Policy is then constructed upon a figure whose uncertainty has been discreetly discarded during translation. Those who generate such figures cannot control that process, but they can refuse to characterize a detection rate as a population. That refusal is unexciting, and it is the whole of the discipline.
qs: Which statement best expresses the main argument of this article?
Camera archives are cheap enough to have replaced most older fieldwork.
Detection rates become reliable counts of animals once enough images have accumulated.
Camera placement on trails is the main weakness of the whole method.
Photographic frequency tracks trends dependably but estimates numbers poorly.

qs.evidence: A detection rate is a robust measure of change at one location over time, and a fragile measure of quantity at any single moment.
qs.answer: Photographic frequency tracks trends dependably but estimates numbers poorly.
qs.why: Inti artikelnya: laju deteksi kuat buat mengukur perubahan di satu lokasi, lemah buat mengukur jumlah pada satu saat. Kunci ini ngomong itu dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Arsip kamera disebut murah dan hampir bebas kehadiran pengamat, tapi nggak pernah disebut menggantikan kerja lapangan lama. Jumlah foto berapa pun nggak menghapus kebutuhan model beserta asumsinya. Dan penempatan di jalur cuma “kesulitan kedua”, sementara inti tulisannya laju deteksi kuat buat perubahan dan lemah buat jumlah.

qs: What can be inferred about abundance estimates for uniformly coloured species?
They are steadier than the counts produced for animals like the tiger.
They stop needing a model once the archive is large enough.
They rest on premises the images themselves are unable to confirm.
They rely on telling each individual apart by its own markings.

qs.evidence: The model requires assumptions about movement, and those assumptions are precisely what the photographs cannot supply.
qs.answer: They rest on premises the images themselves are unable to confirm.
qs.why: Model butuh asumsi soal pergerakan, dan justru asumsi itu yang nggak bisa disediakan foto. Jadi angkanya berdiri di atas premis yang nggak terbukti dari gambar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Harimau justru disebut bisa diidentifikasi dan dihitung dengan percaya diri, jadi bukan yang lebih goyah. Modelnya tetap diperlukan berapa pun besarnya arsip. Dan buat hewan berwarna seragam identifikasi per individu disebut nggak mungkin.

qs: What tone does the closing sentence convey?
Understated conviction about an unglamorous professional duty.
Cautious doubt about whether the method can be trusted at all.
Warm optimism about the influence of fieldwork on a ministry.
Weary irritation at the newspaper that dropped the interval.

qs.evidence: That refusal is unexciting, and it is the whole of the discipline.
qs.answer: Understated conviction about an unglamorous professional duty.
qs.why: Penulis nyebut penolakan itu “unexciting” tapi langsung bilang itulah seluruh disiplinnya. Nadanya yakin tapi ditahan, bukan berbunga-bunga.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kalimat penutup menyebut penolakan itu “unexciting” lalu bilang itulah seluruh disiplinnya: yakin tapi ditahan. Metodenya sudah dibela di paragraf sebelumnya, jadi bukan keraguan. Dan teks bilang penghasil angka nggak bisa mengendalikan proses hilir, bukan optimistis soal kementerian atau marah pada koran.

qs: Which statement best restates what happens to a figure during translation?
Its margin of doubt is widened by the officials who handle it before publication.
Its margin of doubt vanishes, leaving it sounding more certain than warranted.
It is recalculated by a ministry working from a different set of assumptions.
It gains authority because more photographs have since been collected.

qs.evidence: Somewhere between the model and the summary, an estimate loses its interval and acquires an air of authority it never possessed.
qs.answer: Its margin of doubt vanishes, leaving it sounding more certain than warranted.
qs.why: Teks bilang estimasi kehilangan intervalnya dan dapat wibawa yang sebenarnya nggak pernah dia punya. Kunci ini nyatain ulang hal yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang intervalnya lenyap, bukan dilebarkan, dan yang ditambah cuma kesan berwibawa. Nggak ada penghitungan ulang oleh kementerian — kebijakan justru dibangun di atas angka itu apa adanya. Dan wibawanya nggak datang dari foto tambahan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Species that keep away from paths appear more often in the archive than those using them."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Species that keep away from paths appear more often in the archive than those using them.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Cameras are positioned on trails, because trails deliver detections and empty forest does not, so animals that avoid trails are underrepresented while those that patrol them are overrepresented.
qs.why: Teks bilang hewan yang menghindari jalur justru kurang terwakili, sementara yang sering lewat jalur kelebihan wakil. Klaimnya membalik arah itu, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertentangan langsung sama kalimat penempatan kamera. “Not stated” salah karena arah biasnya disebut eksplisit.

author: Jelita Marpaung
setting: a forest monitoring programme

title: The Word on the Sleeve
text:
The recording industry has spent fifty years promoting a term it never defined, and the term is authentic. Gut strings, lower pitch, smaller ensembles, no vibrato: the apparatus of historical performance is now familiar even to listeners who could not name a single instrument in it. The claim attached to the apparatus is considerably more ambitious than the apparatus itself. It asserts that a particular set of choices restores an intention, and intention is precisely what no instrument preserves.

Consider what survives from a performance given in seventeen fifty: a manuscript, sometimes an instrument, occasionally a description written by somebody in the audience. What does not survive is the room as it sounded when full, the expectations of listeners who had heard nothing similar that week, or the silence against which the music was measured. A contemporary audience arrives having heard ten thousand hours of recorded sound, and no arrangement of gut strings subtracts that experience. Restoring the acoustic apparatus therefore restores a fraction, and the missing fraction is the listener.

Advocates reply, reasonably, that partial recovery is preferable to none, and the reply would be conclusive if the movement had described itself modestly, which for its first two decades it did not. Recordings were marketed as definitive; conductors who used later instruments were treated as vandals; a scholarly disagreement about ornament acquired the vocabulary of a moral controversy. The confidence was disproportionate to the evidence, which consisted largely of treatises written by teachers complaining about their pupils. Complaint is evidence of practice, but only of unusual practice, and unusual practice makes poor doctrine.

The strongest defence of the movement concerns nothing so grand as fidelity to the past. Reduced forces expose inner voices that a large ensemble buries; unfamiliar tuning unsettles a listener into attention; a quieter instrument compels a distinct kind of phrasing. These are aesthetic gains, available presently, and they require no claim about intention whatever. The movement produced its finest results precisely when it behaved as an experiment rather than as a restoration.

The vocabulary has softened in recent years, and historically informed has replaced authentic on most sleeves. The retreat is welcome, though conceded gradually and with little acknowledgement of what preceded it. What remains is a body of performance practice considerably more inventive than the doctrine that once justified it. That is a familiar pattern in the arts: the argument ages badly while the work it licensed continues to reward attention. Somebody should tell the sleeve notes.
qs: What is the relationship between restored instruments and a restored performance?
The equipment can be recovered, but the ear that first received it cannot.
Recovering the instruments largely recovers the intention behind the music.
The instruments matter less than the pitch a conductor may decide to adopt.
Recorded sound has trained modern ears to hear much as earlier listeners did.

qs.evidence: Restoring the acoustic apparatus therefore restores a fraction, and the missing fraction is the listener.
qs.answer: The equipment can be recovered, but the ear that first received it cannot.
qs.why: Teks bilang memulihkan perangkat akustik cuma memulihkan sebagian, dan bagian yang hilang itu pendengarnya. Jadi alat bisa dibalikin, telinga penonton lama nggak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang niat justru hal yang nggak dipelihara instrumen apa pun, jadi bukan sesuatu yang ikut pulih. Pitch disebut sebagai salah satu bagian perangkatnya, bukan pembanding yang lebih penting. Dan sepuluh ribu jam rekaman disebut bekal yang nggak bisa dikurangi, bukan pelatihan yang menyamakan telinga.

qs: What does the essay imply about the historical sources used by the movement?
They consist mainly of descriptions written by listeners in the audience.
They record complaints, which are a partial guide to ordinary habit.
They were set aside by scholars who marketed definitive recordings.
They describe the practice that teachers of the period thought normal.

qs.evidence: The confidence was disproportionate to the evidence, which consisted largely of treatises written by teachers complaining about their pupils.
qs.answer: They record complaints, which are a partial guide to ordinary habit.
qs.why: Sumbernya sebagian besar traktat guru yang mengeluhkan murid, dan keluhan cuma memotret yang menyimpang. Jadi panduannya sebagian saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Sumbernya disebut sebagian besar traktat guru yang mengeluhkan murid, bukan catatan penonton, dan keluhan cuma bukti praktik yang nggak lazim — jadi bukan gambaran apa yang dianggap normal. Sumber itu juga dipakai buat menopang kepercayaan diri gerakannya, bukan dikesampingkan.

qs: What effect does the closing sentence create?
A calm summary of what the movement has actually achieved.
A quiet warning about where recorded music is now heading.
A polite instruction addressed to one particular record label.
A wry deflation after a paragraph of serious argument.

qs.evidence: Somebody should tell the sleeve notes.
qs.answer: A wry deflation after a paragraph of serious argument.
qs.why: Setelah paragraf serius, kalimat pendek soal “sleeve notes” itu sengaja mengempeskan nada, ringan dan menyindir sekaligus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kalimat pendek soal “sleeve notes” itu mengempeskan nada setelah paragraf serius, bukan rangkuman pencapaian dan bukan peringatan soal masa depan rekaman. Nggak ada label yang disebut namanya, jadi bukan instruksi ke satu perusahaan.

qs: What does "vandals" convey about conductors using later instruments?
That they had actually damaged some of the surviving historical instruments.
That they were largely shut out of the recording industry by the movement.
That they were held to be careless about ornament without ever meaning any harm.
That they were charged with damaging something rather than interpreting it.

qs.evidence: Recordings were marketed as definitive; conductors who used later instruments were treated as vandals; a scholarly disagreement about ornament acquired the vocabulary of a moral controversy.
qs.answer: That they were charged with damaging something rather than interpreting it.
qs.why: Kalimat itu bilang perselisihan ilmiah dapat kosakata kontroversi moral, jadi kata itu menuduh perusakan, bukan menggambarkan tafsir yang berbeda.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kalimatnya bilang perselisihan ilmiah soal ornamen dapat kosakata kontroversi moral, jadi kata itu menuduh perusakan, bukan kelalaian tanpa niat. Nggak ada instrumen yang benar-benar dirusak, dan nggak ada yang dikeluarkan dari industri rekaman.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The label on most record sleeves has changed to a more cautious phrase."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The label on most record sleeves has changed to a more cautious phrase.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The vocabulary has softened in recent years, and historically informed has replaced authentic on most sleeves.
qs.why: Teks bilang “historically informed” udah menggantikan “authentic” di sebagian besar sampul. Klaimnya cuma merangkum itu dengan kata lain, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh pernyataan bahwa istilahnya tetap, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena pergantian istilahnya disebut langsung.

topic: historical performance and claims of authenticity
author: Kanaya Prabowo
setting: the recorded classical repertoire

title: Forty-One Years, One Line a Day
text:
My grandfather maintained a meteorological diary for forty-one years, in identical notebooks, inscribing a solitary line each morning before the household stirred. Temperature, wind, cloud, and a single adjective of his own election, entered before breakfast and never revised thereafter. He possessed no scientific training, and never submitted a solitary observation to any institution that might conceivably have solicited it. I inherited eleven notebooks and comprehended virtually nothing of their significance until I attempted the same discipline myself.

A diary of this kind chastens the ordinary human appetite for vindication, which is its chief and unadvertised utility. On the fourth morning I recorded that rain was probable, and by midday I desired it. The desire had no connection with rain; it concerned the sentence I had composed, and the distinction required several weeks to clarify itself. My grandfather's entries contain no predictions whatever, which I had originally construed as a deficiency of ambition. It was, I now believe, a deliberate refusal, since a diarist who forecasts nothing possesses nothing to defend.

The notebooks acquire their value only in aggregate, and the aggregate was never his intention, nor could it have been. Read consecutively, they reveal the first frost arriving progressively later across four decades, and the adjectives contracting as his handwriting deteriorated. Neither pattern was perceptible to the diarist holding the pen on any particular Tuesday, accumulating evidence he could not himself interpret. The pattern belongs to the series, not to any entry within it.

I have attempted to justify to a colleague why the notebooks are not merely sentimental objects of family piety. She enquired, quite reasonably, what they establish, and I could not respond in the requisite form. Proof was never the transaction she imagined; they establish nothing in isolation, constituting instead one household's forty-one years of sustained attention, a distinct category of object altogether. A single record proves little and doubts nothing; a long record cannot help doubting the year it happens to occupy.

Nineteen months into my own notebook, I find the adjectives already repeating themselves. I no longer record that rain is probable, and I do not lament the sensation of vindication. What supplanted it is duller and more durable: a mild curiosity concerning what the series will eventually articulate. It will not articulate it to me, of course, since forty-one years is an implausible interval to await a single sentence, and that, presumably, was the arrangement he accepted when he opened the first notebook.
qs: What is the main point the writer draws from the notebooks?
A single careful entry can carry more weight than a long unbroken series.
Patient records gain meaning only as a series, beyond any single observer.
The diaries matter chiefly as objects of family piety and private memory.
Sustained records are wasted unless some institution eventually collects and reads them.

qs.evidence: Neither pattern was perceptible to the diarist holding the pen on any particular Tuesday, accumulating evidence he could not himself interpret.
qs.answer: Patient records gain meaning only as a series, beyond any single observer.
qs.why: Polanya cuma muncul kalau catatannya dibaca berderet, dan orang yang menulisnya nggak bisa melihat itu. Jadi maknanya ada di serinya, bukan di satu pengamat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang catatan tunggal nggak membuktikan dan nggak meragukan apa pun, sementara seri panjang nggak bisa berhenti meragukan tahun yang sedang berjalan. Penulis justru menolak sebutan objek kesalehan keluarga. Dan kakeknya nggak pernah menyerahkan satu pun pengamatan ke lembaga mana pun, dan itu nggak bikin catatannya sia-sia.

qs: What does the writer conclude about the absence of forecasts in the diaries?
It protected the observer from wanting the weather to confirm him.
It followed from his lack of any training rather than from a decision.
It was meant to keep the notebooks usable by later researchers.
It shows he had lost interest in what the next morning would bring.

qs.evidence: It was, I now believe, a deliberate refusal, since a diarist who forecasts nothing possesses nothing to defend.
qs.answer: It protected the observer from wanting the weather to confirm him.
qs.why: Kalau kamu nggak meramal, kamu nggak punya apa pun buat dibela. Itu yang bikin penulis nyimpulin kakeknya terlindung dari keinginan dibenarkan cuaca.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penulis menyebutnya penolakan yang disengaja, jadi bukan akibat ketiadaan pelatihan. Kegunaan buat peneliti nggak pernah jadi niatnya — agregatnya sendiri bukan tujuannya. Dan catatannya tetap ditulis tiap pagi selama empat puluh satu tahun, jadi bukan tanda kehilangan minat.

qs: How does the writer characterize the change in his own attitude?
As a loss he still quietly resents after nineteen months of trying.
As an exchange of vindication for something duller and steadier.
As a sudden change brought on by a colleague's blunt question.
As evidence that his grandfather had been mistaken from the start.

qs.evidence: What supplanted it is duller and more durable: a mild curiosity concerning what the series will eventually articulate.
qs.answer: As an exchange of vindication for something duller and steadier.
qs.why: Kata “duller and more durable” plus “mild curiosity” nunjukin dia nuker sensasi benar sama sesuatu yang lebih tenang dan tahan lama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Yang menggantikannya disebut “duller and more durable”, rasa penasaran ringan, dan dia bilang nggak menyesalinya. Pertanyaan rekannya bikin dia nggak bisa menjawab dalam bentuk yang diminta, bukan bikin perubahan mendadak. Dan kakeknya nggak pernah disebut keliru.

qs: Which sentence best restates the contrast drawn between short and long records?
One entry can be trusted further than a series compiled across decades.
A long series removes the doubt that any single year would otherwise raise.
One entry settles nothing, whereas a long series questions the present year.
Short and long records do the same work, only at a different scale.

qs.evidence: A single record proves little and doubts nothing; a long record cannot help doubting the year it happens to occupy.
qs.answer: One entry settles nothing, whereas a long series questions the present year.
qs.why: Kalimatnya bilang catatan tunggal nggak membuktikan dan nggak meragukan apa pun, sementara catatan panjang otomatis meragukan tahun yang sedang berjalan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kalimatnya bilang catatan tunggal nggak membuktikan sekaligus nggak meragukan apa pun, jadi bukan yang lebih bisa dipercaya. Seri panjang justru nggak bisa berhenti meragukan tahun yang dia tempati. Dan keduanya disebut kategori objek yang berbeda, bukan skala berbeda dari kerja yang sama.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Across the four decades the first frost appeared progressively later in the season."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Across the four decades the first frost appeared progressively later in the season.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Read consecutively, they reveal the first frost arriving progressively later across four decades, and the adjectives contracting as his handwriting deteriorated.
qs.why: Teks bilang embun beku pertama datang makin telat sepanjang empat dekade. Klaimnya cuma ganti pilihan kata, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh arah sebaliknya, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena polanya disebut eksplisit di kalimat itu.

topic: a private weather diary and the value of long records
author: Laras Mahendra
setting: an inherited set of notebooks

title: Forty Encounters a Week
text:
Housing research has produced few findings as robust, or as regularly ignored, as the relationship between circulation and acquaintance. Residents who pass one another on foot, at a predictable hour, in a space narrow enough to require acknowledgement, recognize one another's faces. Residents who arrive by lift, from a basement, into a corridor with sixteen identical doors, do not. The distinction has been demonstrated repeatedly, in four countries, employing three separate methods and yielding one conclusion, since the decisive variable is not community spirit but the geometry of the route.

The mechanism is unremarkable once stated, and the literature has described it since the nineteen-sixties without appreciable dissent; recognition requires repetition, and repetition requires a shared route. A staircase serving six flats generates roughly forty encounters a week for each household; a lift serving ninety flats generates a similar number of strangers. Encounters need not be conversations, and residents in the studied blocks rarely reported friendship. They reported something weaker and more valuable, namely the ability to distinguish a neighbour from an intruder.

The finding has an awkward corollary planning authorities dislike quoting: staircase access is costly, consuming floor area that produces no rent and limiting the height of an economic structure. Lift-and-corridor arrangements are more economical for every party except the resident, whose costs appear years later and in forms nobody attributes to a drawing. Absence of acquaintance is not itemized in a development appraisal, nor in any subsequent valuation. It arrives instead as reported anxiety, as unattended shared space, and as maintenance disputes no committee can settle.

Two qualifications intrude before the finding is applied too enthusiastically. First, the studies compare structures, not residents, and households choosing a staircase block may differ from those allocated a tower. Second, acquaintance is not uniformly desirable, and several respondents described the staircase as terrain they could not cross unobserved. Visibility protects and constrains simultaneously, which is why the same arrangement is described as neighbourly by one household and oppressive by the next.

The policy implication is modest and therefore unattractive to announce at a ribbon-cutting. Nothing in the evidence recommends demolishing towers or prohibiting lifts, and any such proposal would be absurd. It recommends that circulation be treated as a social instrument rather than as a technical residue, and costed accordingly. Costing it, however, requires a vocabulary appraisals do not currently possess. A staircase is not a corridor standing on end; it is the cheapest social programme a building can contain, and it is usually deleted first.
qs: Which statement best expresses the central finding reported here?
Whether neighbours recognize each other depends chiefly on how they move about.
Community spirit may matter more to recognition than the shape of a route.
Corridor residents usually report more friendships than staircase households.
The finding has been contested by researchers in each of the four countries.

qs.evidence: the decisive variable is not community spirit but the geometry of the route
qs.answer: Whether neighbours recognize each other depends chiefly on how they move about.
qs.why: Teks bilang penentunya bukan semangat kebersamaan, tapi bentuk jalur pergerakan. Kunci ini merumuskan ulang temuan itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang variabel penentunya bukan semangat kebersamaan tapi geometri jalur, jadi urutannya kebalik di pengecoh pertama. Pertemanan justru jarang dilaporkan penghuni mana pun, dan yang bertambah cuma kemampuan mengenali wajah. Dan temuan itu disebut berulang kali terbukti di empat negara tanpa perbedaan pendapat berarti.

qs: What can be inferred about how developers assess circulation?
Their calculations favour staircases, since floor area without rent is cheap.
They price resident anxiety into the appraisal as a long-term maintenance risk.
They ask residents which access arrangement they would prefer to pay for.
Their calculations omit expenses that surface long after completion.

qs.evidence: Lift-and-corridor arrangements are more economical for every party except the resident, whose costs appear years later and in forms nobody attributes to a drawing.
qs.answer: Their calculations omit expenses that surface long after completion.
qs.why: Biaya yang ditanggung penghuni muncul bertahun-tahun kemudian dan nggak dikaitkan orang ke gambar rancangan. Artinya hitungan pengembang nggak memuat biaya itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tangga justru disebut mahal karena memakan luas lantai yang nggak menghasilkan sewa, jadi bukan pilihan murah. Kecemasan penghuni dinyatakan nggak masuk daftar biaya di penilaian pengembangan mana pun. Dan konsultasi ke penghuni sama sekali nggak disebut teks.

qs: What attitude is conveyed by the article's final sentence?
Even-handed description of how corridors and staircases are costed.
Pointed regret at a predictable order of budget reductions.
Confidence that appraisals will soon acquire the missing vocabulary.
Approval of a proposal to stop building lifts in tall blocks.

qs.evidence: A staircase is not a corridor standing on end; it is the cheapest social programme a building can contain, and it is usually deleted first.
qs.answer: Pointed regret at a predictable order of budget reductions.
qs.why: Frasa “usually deleted first” itu sindiran pahit: hal paling murah dan paling bernilai sosial justru yang pertama dipangkas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kalimat penutupnya bilang program sosial termurah itu justru yang pertama dihapus — itu sindiran, bukan deskripsi berimbang. Teks juga bilang kosakata buat menghitungnya belum ada, tanpa janji bakal segera datang. Dan larangan lift disebut eksplisit sebagai hal yang absurd.

qs: In the final paragraph, what does "residue" imply about circulation?
That it is the waste material a contractor removes from the site.
That it begins to earn rent once the upper floors have all been let.
That it must be costed before any other floor area is assigned.
That it is treated as whatever remains after the priorities are settled.

qs.evidence: It recommends that circulation be treated as a social instrument rather than as a technical residue, and costed accordingly.
qs.answer: That it is treated as whatever remains after the priorities are settled.
qs.why: Kata itu dikontraskan sama “social instrument”, jadi maknanya sisa teknis yang cuma kebagian ruang setelah hal-hal utama diputuskan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kata itu dipasang berlawanan dengan “social instrument”, jadi maksudnya sisa teknis, bukan limbah bangunan. Teks bilang ruang sirkulasi nggak menghasilkan sewa sama sekali. Dan justru pokok tuntutan penulis adalah biaya itu belum pernah dihitung, bukan dihitung paling awal.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Residents of the blocks studied usually described their neighbours as friends."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Residents of the blocks studied usually described their neighbours as friends.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Encounters need not be conversations, and residents in the studied blocks rarely reported friendship.
qs.why: Teks bilang penghuni jarang melaporkan pertemanan. Klaimnya membalik frekuensi itu jadi “biasanya”, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak kata “rarely”. “Not stated” salah karena laporan soal pertemanan disebut langsung.

author: Mahesa Rizkiawan
setting: housing blocks in a comparative study

title: The Composite Bear
text:
A polar bear crosses the ice, and the music informs you she is exhausted before the narrator confirms it. The sequence is exquisite, extravagant, and constructed from footage gathered over fourteen months by six camera teams in three locations. The bear on screen is therefore not a bear but a composite, assembled to depict an existence that no single animal was filmed living. This is not a scandal, though it is periodically reported as one.

Every documentary compresses, and compression requires decisions that cannot be made neutrally. A hunt that failed eleven times and succeeded once will be shown succeeding, because failure eleven times is unwatchable. Predation is filmed and edited to conclude; the protracted tedium that surrounds it is excised entirely. Viewers consequently acquire an impression of the wild as continuously eventful, which inverts what a field biologist reports. The genre's honesty problem is not deception about individual shots but a systematic exaggeration of incident.

The narration performs a second kind of editing, and it operates on motive rather than on time. Animals are accorded intentions, kinship, courage, and occasionally grief, because a sequence without a protagonist is arduous to sustain for fifty minutes. Ascribing purpose is not simply an error, since much animal behaviour genuinely is purposive. The difficulty is that the ascribed purposes are invariably legible to us: the devoted parent, the ageing rival, the resourceful outsider. We recognize the plot before we recognize the species.

Defenders of the genre make an argument from consequence, and it deserves to be taken seriously. These programmes have generated more public support for conservation than the entire peer-reviewed literature combined. An audience moved by a composite bear will still sign a petition about actual ice. The objection is not that the argument is erroneous but that it has never been examined by the individuals who make it most often.

A modest reform would demand almost nothing of the genre and would repair much of the difficulty. Several recent series now append a brief account of how a sequence was obtained, and the appendix is frequently the most admired segment. Audiences are not damaged by learning that patience, luck, and fourteen months preceded ninety seconds of ice. They are damaged by an impression, silently acquired, that the wild is a domain where something invariably occurs. The remedy is precisely the practice the genre has invariably excelled at, which is exhibiting the labour.
qs: What relationship does the writer draw between editing and misleading the viewer?
Individual shots are staged, and the narration is written to cover this.
The narration corrects the exaggeration that the editing has introduced.
Individual shots are truthful, yet their assembly overstates how much occurs.
Assembly is neutral, since every decision about the footage can be justified afterwards.

qs.evidence: The genre's honesty problem is not deception about individual shots but a systematic exaggeration of incident.
qs.answer: Individual shots are truthful, yet their assembly overstates how much occurs.
qs.why: Masalahnya bukan tipu-tipu di tiap bidikan, tapi pembesaran kejadian secara sistematis waktu semuanya dirangkai. Itu isi kunci ini.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks eksplisit bilang masalahnya bukan penipuan di tiap bidikan, jadi bukan adegan yang dipentaskan. Narasi disebut menjalankan lapisan penyuntingan kedua atas motif, jadi menambah bukan mengoreksi. Dan pemadatan disebut menuntut keputusan yang nggak bisa diambil secara netral.

qs: What can be inferred about how viewers perceive predation?
They will assume hunting succeeds far more often than it does.
They will usually assume each sequence was filmed by one camera team.
They will notice the failures that the edit has removed.
They will tend to lose interest long before a hunt reaches its end.

qs.evidence: A hunt that failed eleven times and succeeded once will be shown succeeding, because failure eleven times is unwatchable.
qs.answer: They will assume hunting succeeds far more often than it does.
qs.why: Kalau yang ditayangkan cuma perburuan yang berhasil dari dua belas percobaan, penonton bakal ngira tingkat keberhasilannya jauh lebih tinggi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Jumlah tim kamera cuma keterangan produksi, bukan kesan yang terbentuk di penonton. Kegagalan sebelas kali justru dibuang karena nggak bisa ditonton, jadi nggak ada yang bisa dikenali. Dan perburuan disunting supaya selesai, jadi bukan penonton yang bosan di tengah.

qs: The remark about recognizing the plot chiefly serves to do which of these?
Praise narrators who convey grief in an ageing rival convincingly.
Concede that viewers cannot identify the species on screen at all.
Expose how narrative convention overrides observation of the animal.
Recommend that sequences be shown without any narration at all.

qs.evidence: We recognize the plot before we recognize the species.
